scripts.title: ARTEM HUB | ПОИСК СЕРВЕРОВ ГДЕ МАЛО ЛЮДЕЙ!
scripts.author: Isidjsjsizjjzjzfkdk
scripts.description:
Как работает скрипт? Скрипт ищет сервер где мало людей 1-2 и запускает он вас туда.                     скрипт технически будет работать, но в очень популярных плейсах (например, Blox Fruits, Adopt Me, Brookhaven) есть важные нюансы:

Как работает поиск: Скрипт отправляет запрос к серверам Роблокса с параметром sortOrder=Asc (сортировка по возрастанию). Это значит, что Роблокс принудительно отдаёт сначала самые пустые сервера (где 1–2 игрока).
Проблема «быстрого заполнения»: В плейсах-гигантах миллионы людей постоянно заходят в игру. Если скрипт найдёт сервер с 1 игроком и начнет телепортацию, за те 2–3 секунды, пока у вас загружается игра, на этот сервер могут зайти ещё 10 человек через обычный Quick Play.
Итог: Скрипт найдёт сервер с 1-2 игроками даже при онлайне в 1 000 000, но из-за бешеного потока людей этот сервер может мгновенно заполниться прямо во время вашего подключения.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlaceId = game.PlaceId

local BG1 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14)
local BG2 = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22)
local ACC = Color3.fromRGB(130, 120, 255)
local TXT = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 250)
local TXT2 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 140)

local MIN_P, MAX_P = 1, 2

local function create(class, parent, props)
    local inst = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do inst[k] = v end
    inst.Parent = parent
    return inst
end

-- GUI Setup
local gui = create("ScreenGui", player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"), {Name = "AH_Fox", ResetOnSpawn = false})
local main = create("Frame", gui, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 250),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -140, 0.5, -125),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG1,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})
create("UICorner", main, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)})
create("UIStroke", main, {Color = ACC, Thickness = 1, Transparency = 0.4})

-- Header
local header = create("Frame", main, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG2,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})
create("UICorner", header, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)})

create("TextLabel", header, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "ARTEM HUB <font color='#8278FF'>foxname</font>",
    RichText = true,
    TextColor3 = TXT,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    TextSize = 13,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
})

local close = create("TextButton", header, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0.5, -12),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG1,
    Text = "×",
    TextColor3 = TXT2,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    TextSize = 15,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})
create("UICorner", close, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)})

-- Info Card
local info = create("Frame", main, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 44),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 50),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG2,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})
create("UICorner", info, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)})

local function addStat(title, val, xOffset, color)
    create("TextLabel", info, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0.4, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(xOffset, 10, 0, 4),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = title,
        TextColor3 = TXT2,
        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
        TextSize = 8,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    })
    return create("TextLabel", info, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -10, 0.5, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(xOffset, 10, 0.4, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = val,
        TextColor3 = color or TXT,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 11,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    })
end

local pCount = addStat("ТЕКУЩИЙ СЕРВЕР", #Players:GetPlayers() .. " игр.", 0)
addStat("ЦЕЛЬ ПОИСКА", "1-2 игр.", 0.5, ACC)

-- Settings Input (Min / Max Players)
local setFrame = create("Frame", main, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 36),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 102),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG2,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})
create("UICorner", setFrame, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)})

create("TextLabel", setFrame, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "Лимит игроков:",
    TextColor3 = TXT,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
    TextSize = 10,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
})

local function addInput(def, xPos, callback)
    local box = create("TextBox", setFrame, {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 22),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, xPos, 0.5, -11),
        BackgroundColor3 = BG1,
        Text = tostring(def),
        TextColor3 = ACC,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 10,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ClearTextOnFocus = false
    })
    create("UICorner", box, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)})
    box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
        local val = tonumber(box.Text)
        if val then callback(val) else box.Text = tostring(def) end
    end)
end

addInput(MIN_P, -70, function(v) MIN_P = v end)
addInput(MAX_P, -35, function(v) MAX_P = v end)

-- Status Bar
local sBar = create("Frame", main, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 24),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 146),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG2,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})
create("UICorner", sBar, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)})

local sDot = create("Frame", sBar, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 6),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -3),
    BackgroundColor3 = TXT2,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})
create("UICorner", sDot, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})

local sTxt = create("TextLabel", sBar, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "ожидание",
    TextColor3 = TXT2,
    Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
    TextSize = 9,
    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
})

-- Progress Bar
local pBg = create("Frame", main, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 2),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 178),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG2,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})
local pFill = create("Frame", pBg, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = ACC,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})

-- Find Button
local btn = create("TextButton", main, {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 36),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 188),
    BackgroundColor3 = ACC,
    Text = "Найти сервер",
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    TextSize = 12,
    BorderSizePixel = 0
})
create("UICorner", btn, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)})

-- Floating Toggle Button
local float = create("TextButton", gui, {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 36, 0, 36),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 1, -50),
    BackgroundColor3 = BG1,
    Text = "A",
    TextColor3 = ACC,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    TextSize = 14,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    Visible = false
})
create("UICorner", float, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})
create("UIStroke", float, {Color = ACC, Thickness = 1})

-- Show / Hide logic
local function setUI(open)
    main.Visible = open
    float.Visible = not open
end
close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setUI(false) end)
float.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setUI(true) end)

-- Smooth Dragging for Mobile / PC
local dragging, dragStart, startPos
header.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging, dragStart, startPos = true, i.Position, main.Position
        i.Changed:Connect(function() if i.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end end)
    end
end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
    if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = i.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- Auto Update Player Count
task.spawn(function()
    while main.Parent do
        pCount.Text = #Players:GetPlayers() .. " игр."
        task.wait(3)
    end
end)

-- Server Hop Logic
local function findSmallServer()
    sTxt.Text, sDot.BackgroundColor3 = "сканирование...", Color3.fromRGB(240, 180, 50)
    pFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
    
    local cursor = ""
    local attempts = 0
    local checked = 0
    local best = nil

    while attempts < 15 do
        attempts = attempts + 1
        pFill.Size = UDim2.new(attempts / 15, 0, 1, 0)
        
        local url = string.format("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100&cursor=%s", PlaceId, cursor)
        local ok, response = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(game:HttpGet(url)) end)

        if not ok or not response or not response.data then
            sTxt.Text, sDot.BackgroundColor3 = "ошибка API", Color3.fromRGB(240, 50, 50)
            return nil
        end

        for _, s in ipairs(response.data) do
            checked = checked + 1
            sTxt.Text = string.format("проверка #%d (%d игр.)", checked, s.playing)
            task.wait(0.01)

            if s.playing >= MIN_P and s.playing <= MAX_P and s.id ~= game.JobId then
                if not best or s.playing < best.playing then best = s end
            end
        end

        if best then break end
        cursor = response.nextPageCursor or ""
        if cursor == "" then break end
        task.wait(0.1)
    end

    if best then
        pFill.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        sTxt.Text, sDot.BackgroundColor3 = "сервер найден!", Color3.fromRGB(50, 240, 100)
        return best.id
    end

    sTxt.Text, sDot.BackgroundColor3 = "не найдено", Color3.fromRGB(240, 50, 50)
    return nil
end

btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not btn.Active then return end
    btn.Active = false
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = BG2
    btn.Text = "Поиск..."

    task.spawn(function()
        local jobId = findSmallServer()
        if jobId then
            sTxt.Text = "телепортация..."
            task.wait(0.5)
            pcall(function() TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(PlaceId, jobId, player) end)
        end
        task.wait(1)
        btn.Active = true
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = ACC
        btn.Text = "Найти сервер"
    end)
end)

    Fill.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local pos = math.clamp((x-Bar.AbsolutePosition.X)/Bar.AbsoluteSize.X,0,1)

        end
    end)

-- ========== ПРОВЕРКА ЖИВОЙ ЛИ ИГРОК ==========
local function IsAlive(p)
    if not p or not p.Character then return false end
    -- 1. Атрибут Dead на персонаже
    local dead = p.Character:GetAttribute("Dead")
    if dead == true then return false end
    -- 2. Атрибут Dead на игроке
    dead = p:GetAttribute("Dead")
    if dead == true then return false end
    -- 3. Проверка Health
    local hp = p.Character:GetAttribute("Health")
    if hp ~= nil and hp <= 0 then return false end
    -- 4. Проверка Humanoid (если есть)
    local hum = p.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then return false end
    -- 5. Head должен быть
    local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return false end
    -- 6. Проверка что голова ещё в Workspace (не удалена)
    if not head:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return false end
    return true
end

-- ========== КОМАНДА ==========
local function GetTeam(plr)
    if not plr then return nil end
    local t = plr:GetAttribute("Team")
    if t then return tostring(t) end
    if plr.Character then
        t = plr.Character:GetAttribute("Team")
        if t then return tostring(t) end
    end
    local ls = plr:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
    if ls then
        local tv = ls:FindFirstChild("Team") or ls:FindFirstChild("team")
        if tv and tv.Value then return tostring(tv.Value) end
    end
    if plr.Team then return tostring(plr.Team) end
    return nil
end

local function IsTeammate(p)
    if not _G.Z.Team then return false end
    if p == LP then return true end
    local mt = GetTeam(LP)
    local pt = GetTeam(p)
    if mt and pt then return mt == pt end
    return false
end

local function UpdateTeamInfo()
    local mt = GetTeam(LP)
    if mt then
        TeamInfo.Text = "✅ Моя команда: " .. mt
        TeamInfo.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,150)
    else
        TeamInfo.Text = "⚠️ Команда не найдена"
        TeamInfo.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,200,0)
    end
end
UpdateTeamInfo()

-- ========== WALL CHECK ==========
local function HasLineOfSight(targetPart)
    if not _G.Z.WallCheck then return true end
    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LP.Character}
    params.IgnoreWater = true
    local origin = Cam.CFrame.Position
    local dir = targetPart.Position - origin
    local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, params)
    if not result then return true end
    return result.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent)
end

-- ========== HITBOX EXPANDER ==========
local OrigSizes = {}

function ExpandHitboxes()
    if not _G.Z.HitboxEnabled then return end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP and p.Character and IsAlive(p) then
            if not IsTeammate(p) then
                for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        if not OrigSizes[part] then
                            OrigSizes[part] = part.Size
                        end
                        if part.Name == "Head" or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
                            local s = _G.Z.HitboxSize
                            part.Size = Vector3.new(s, s, s)
                            part.CanCollide = false
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

function RestoreHitboxes()
    for part, size in pairs(OrigSizes) do
        pcall(function()
            if part and part.Parent then
                part.Size = size
            end
        end)
    end
    OrigSizes = {}
end

function ApplyMyHitbox()
    if not LP.Character then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(LP.Character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") and (part.Name == "Head" or part.Name == "HumanoidRootPart") then
            local s = _G.Z.MyHitboxSize
            if s < 2 then
                part.Size = Vector3.new(s, s, s)
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ========== VALID TARGET ==========
local function IsValidTarget(p, skipWall)
    if p == LP then return false end
    if not IsAlive(p) then return false end -- МЁРТВЫХ НЕ БЕРЁМ
    if IsTeammate(p) then return false end
    local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if not head then return false end
    if LP.Character then
        local myHead = LP.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if myHead then
            local dy = head.Position.Y - myHead.Position.Y
            if dy > 150 or dy < -150 then return false end
        end
    end
    if (head.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).Magnitude > 2000 then return false end
    if not skipWall and not HasLineOfSight(head) then return false end
    return true
end

-- ========== ESP (с проверкой на смерть) ==========
local ESPObj = {}
function ClearESP()
    for _,o in ipairs(ESPObj) do pcall(function() o:Destroy() end) end
    ESPObj = {}
end

function DoESP()
    ClearESP()
    if not _G.Z.ESP then return end
    for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        -- ✅ ГЛАВНОЕ: пропускаем мёртвых
        if p ~= LP and IsAlive(p) then
            local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head and hrp then
                local isTeam = IsTeammate(p)
                local color = isTeam and Color3.fromRGB(0,255,100) or Color3.fromRGB(255,60,110)
                if _G.Z.Box then
                    local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
                    box.Size = Vector3.new(3,5,2.5)
                    box.Adornee = hrp
                    box.Color3 = color
                    box.Transparency = 0.5
                    box.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    box.ZIndex = 5
                    box.Parent = hrp
                    table.insert(ESPObj, box)
                end
                if _G.Z.Name or _G.Z.Dist then
                    local bg = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
                    bg.Size = UDim2.new(0,150,0,70)
                    bg.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0,3,0)
                    bg.Adornee = head
                    bg.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    bg.Parent = head
                    table.insert(ESPObj, bg)
                    if _G.Z.Name then
                        local n = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                        n.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,22)
                        n.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        n.Text = p.Name .. (isTeam and " ★" or "")
                        n.TextColor3 = color
                        n.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                        n.TextScaled = true
                        n.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
                        n.Parent = bg
                    end
                    if _G.Z.Dist then
                        local d = Instance.new("TextLabel")
                        d.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,18)
                        d.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,26)
                        d.BackgroundTransparency = 1
                        d.Text = math.floor((Cam.CFrame.Position - head.Position).Magnitude).."m"
                        d.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220,220,235)
                        d.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
                        d.TextScaled = true
                        d.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
                        d.Parent = bg
                    end
                end
                if _G.Z.Tracer then
                    local line = Instance.new("Frame")
                    line.BackgroundColor3 = color
                    line.BorderSizePixel = 0
                    line.ZIndex = 5
                    line.Parent = SG
                    table.insert(ESPObj, line)
                    task.spawn(function()
                        while line.Parent and head.Parent and IsAlive(p) do
                            local sp, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                            if on then
                                local origin = Vector2.new(Cam.ViewportSize.X/2, Cam.ViewportSize.Y)
                                local target = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
                                local diff = target - origin
                                local length = diff.Magnitude
                                local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(diff.Y, diff.X))
                                line.Size = UDim2.new(0, length, 0, 1.5)
                                line.Position = UDim2.new(0, origin.X, 0, origin.Y)
                                line.Rotation = angle
                                line.Visible = true
                            else
                                line.Visible = false
                            end
                            RS.RenderStepped:Wait()
                        end
                        line:Destroy()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ========== AIMBOT ==========
local function GetClosestHead()
    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    local center = Vector2.new(Cam.ViewportSize.X/2, Cam.ViewportSize.Y/2)
    for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if IsValidTarget(p) then
            local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head then
                local sp, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                if on then
                    local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    if d <= _G.Z.FOV and d < bestDist then
                        bestDist = d
                        best = head
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function ShouldAim()
    if not _G.Z.Aim then return false end
    if not LP.Character then return false end
    if not LP.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then return false end
    if _G.Z.UseAimKey and not aimKeyHeld then return false end
    if _G.Z.AimOnShoot then
        if not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
            if not (isMobile and aimKeyHeld) then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end

RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.Z.FOVCircle and _G.Z.Aim then
        local size = _G.Z.FOV * 2
        FovCircle.Size = UDim2.new(0, size, 0, size)
        FovCircle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -size/2, 0.5, -size/2)
        FovCircle.Visible = true
    else
        FovCircle.Visible = false
    end
end)

RS:BindToRenderStep("ZorikAim", 201, function()
    if not ShouldAim() then return end
    local head = GetClosestHead()
    if not head then return end
    local targetPos = head.Position
    local myPos = Cam.CFrame.Position
    if _G.Z.Silent then
        local origCF = Cam.CFrame
        Cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(origCF.Position, targetPos)
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait()
            if Cam and Cam.CFrame then Cam.CFrame = origCF end
        end)
    elseif _G.Z.Legit then
        local curDir = Cam.CFrame.LookVector
        local tgtDir = (targetPos - myPos).Unit
        local smooth = math.max(0.01, 1 / _G.Z.Smooth)
        local newDir = curDir:Lerp(tgtDir, smooth)
        Cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(myPos, myPos + newDir)
    else
        local newCF = CFrame.new(myPos, targetPos)
        Cam.CFrame = Cam.CFrame:Lerp(newCF, 0.5)
    end
end)

-- ========== TRIGGERBOT ==========
local lastShot = 0
RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not _G.Z.Trigger then return end
    if not LP.Character then return end
    if tick() - lastShot < 0.1 then return end
    local myHRP = LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myHRP then return end
    for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if IsValidTarget(p) then
            local head = p.Character:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local hrp = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head and hrp then
                local sp, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
                if on then
                    local center = Vector2.new(Cam.ViewportSize.X/2, Cam.ViewportSize.Y/2)
                    local dist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
                    local worldDist = (hrp.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < 40 and worldDist < _G.Z.TriggerRange then
                        pcall(function()
                            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(0,0,0,true,game,1)
                            task.wait(0.01)
                            VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(0,0,0,false,game,1)
                        end)
                        lastShot = tick()
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ========== FLY ==========
local flyBV = nil
function FlyOn()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return end
    flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
    flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1,1,1)*9e9
    flyBV.Parent = hrp
end
function FlyOff()
    if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy() flyBV = nil end
end
RS.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if flyBV and LP.Character then
        local hrp = LP.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp then
            local spd = 50
            local mv = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then mv = mv + hrp.CFrame.LookVector*spd end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then mv = mv - hrp.CFrame.LookVector*spd end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then mv = mv - hrp.CFrame.RightVector*spd end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then mv = mv + hrp.CFrame.RightVector*spd end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then mv = mv + Vector3.new(0,spd,0) end
            flyBV.Velocity = mv
        end
    end
end)

                    if _G.Z.HitboxEnabled then

                        ExpandHitboxes()
                    end
                end)
            end
            task.wait(1)
        end
    end)
end

part.Material = targetMat part.Color = targetCol end end) end end end) Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) if player.Character then removeChams(player.Character) end end) end) -- Помещаем hookAnimationReload(weapon.CharacterAnimator) end end if not (Toggles.InstantReload and Toggles.InstantReload.Value) then return end if weapon.IsReloading then pcall(function() if weapon.Viewmodel and -- Apple Hub | Ultimate Edition (Fixed Avatar & Auto-Shoot)
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Drawing Objects (FOV & Tracers)
local FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVCircle.Thickness = 1.5
FOVCircle.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FOVCircle.Radius = 120
FOVCircle.Filled = false
FOVCircle.Visible = false

local MurdererTracer = Drawing.new("Line")
MurdererTracer.Thickness = 1.5
MurdererTracer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
MurdererTracer.Visible = false

local GunTracer = Drawing.new("Line")
GunTracer.Thickness = 1.5
GunTracer.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
GunTracer.Visible = false

-- GUI Container
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AppleHubGUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false

pcall(function()
    ScreenGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
end)
if not ScreenGui.Parent then
    ScreenGui.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

-- Main Glass Frame
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 560, 0, 350)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -280, 0.5, -175)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 28)
MainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

local MainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
MainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 16)
MainCorner.Parent = MainFrame

local MainStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
MainStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MainStroke.Transparency = 0.88
MainStroke.Thickness = 1
MainStroke.Parent = MainFrame

-- Dragging System (PC & Mobile)
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
MainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = MainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
        end)
    end
end)
MainFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- Top Bar
local TopBar = Instance.new("Frame")
TopBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
TopBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
TopBar.Parent = MainFrame

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Text = "   Apple Hub | MM2"
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Title.TextSize = 15
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 245)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0, 0)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 1, 0)
Title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Parent = TopBar

local CloseBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
CloseBtn.Text = "✕"
CloseBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
CloseBtn.TextSize = 12
CloseBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 210)
CloseBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 26)
CloseBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -13)
CloseBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
CloseBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.92
CloseBtn.Parent = TopBar

local CloseCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
CloseCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
CloseCorner.Parent = CloseBtn

CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    FOVCircle:Remove()
    MurdererTracer:Remove()
    GunTracer:Remove()
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Sidebar Navigation
local Sidebar = Instance.new("Frame")
Sidebar.Size = UDim2.new(0, 135, 1, -40)
Sidebar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 40)
Sidebar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Sidebar.Parent = MainFrame

local SidebarList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
SidebarList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
SidebarList.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
SidebarList.Parent = Sidebar

local ContentArea = Instance.new("Frame")
ContentArea.Size = UDim2.new(1, -145, 1, -48)
ContentArea.Position = UDim2.new(0, 140, 0, 42)
ContentArea.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ContentArea.Parent = MainFrame

local Pages = {}
local TabButtons = {}

local function CreateTab(name)
    local TabBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    TabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 122, 0, 32)
    TabBtn.Text = "  " .. name
    TabBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    TabBtn.TextSize = 11
    TabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)
    TabBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    TabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    TabBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.96
    TabBtn.Parent = Sidebar

    local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    BtnCorner.Parent = TabBtn

    local Page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    Page.Size = UDim2.new(1, -5, 1, 0)
    Page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Page.ScrollBarThickness = 2
    Page.Visible = false
    Page.Parent = ContentArea

    local PageList = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
    PageList.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
    PageList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
    PageList.Parent = Page

    Pages[name] = Page
    TabButtons[name] = TabBtn

    TabBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for tabName, btn in pairs(TabButtons) do
            TweenService:Create(btn, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
                BackgroundTransparency = (tabName == name) and 0.86 or 0.96,
                TextColor3 = (tabName == name) and Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255) or Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 165)
            }):Play()
        end
        for pageName, pageFrame in pairs(Pages) do
            pageFrame.Visible = (pageName == name)
        end
    end)

    return Page
end

-- UI Helpers
local function AddToggle(parent, text, default, callback)
    local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
    Frame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 36)
    Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40)
    Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    Frame.Parent = parent

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    Corner.Parent = Frame

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Text = text
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    Label.TextSize = 11
    Label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 240)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0)
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(0.7, 0, 1, 0)
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Parent = Frame

    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.Text = default and "ON" or "OFF"
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Btn.TextSize = 10
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 22)
    Btn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0.5, -11)
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = default and Color3.fromRGB(52, 199, 89) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
    Btn.Parent = Frame

    local BtnCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    BtnCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
    BtnCorner.Parent = Btn

    local state = default
    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        state = not state
        Btn.Text = state and "ON" or "OFF"
        Btn.BackgroundColor3 = state and Color3.fromRGB(52, 199, 89) or Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 70)
        callback(state)
    end)
end

local function AddButton(parent, text, callback)
    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 36)
    Btn.Text = text
    Btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    Btn.TextSize = 11
    Btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40)
    Btn.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
    Btn.Parent = parent

    local Corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    Corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    Corner.Parent = Btn

    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- Helper Functions
local function GetDroppedGun()
    return workspace:FindFirstChild("GunDrop", true)
end

local function GetMurderer()
    for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            if plr.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife") or plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Knife") then
                return plr
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

-- Tabs Initialization
local HomePage = CreateTab("Home")
local MainTab = CreateTab("Main")
local PlayerPage = CreateTab("Player")
local VisualsPage = CreateTab("Visuals")
local SettingsPage = CreateTab("Settings")

TabButtons["Home"].BackgroundTransparency = 0.86
TabButtons["Home"].TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Pages["Home"].Visible = true

-- ==================== HOME TAB ====================
local WelcomeTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
WelcomeTitle.Text = "Welcome to Apple Hub"
WelcomeTitle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
WelcomeTitle.TextSize = 16
WelcomeTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
WelcomeTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
WelcomeTitle.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
WelcomeTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
WelcomeTitle.Parent = HomePage

local StatusCard = Instance.new("Frame")
StatusCard.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 54)
StatusCard.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40)
StatusCard.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
StatusCard.Parent = HomePage

local StatusCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
StatusCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
StatusCorner.Parent = StatusCard

-- Круглая аватарка игрока (Исправленная загрузка)
local AvatarImg = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
AvatarImg.Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38)
AvatarImg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, -19)
AvatarImg.BackgroundTransparency = 1
AvatarImg.Parent = StatusCard

task.spawn(function()
    pcall(function()
        local content, isReady = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(LocalPlayer.UserId, Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot, Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size150x150)
        if content then
            AvatarImg.Image = content
        end
    end)
end)

local AvatarCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
AvatarCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
AvatarCorner.Parent = AvatarImg

local AvatarStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
AvatarStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
AvatarStroke.Transparency = 0.8
AvatarStroke.Thickness = 1
AvatarStroke.Parent = AvatarImg

local SystemStatus = Instance.new("TextLabel")
SystemStatus.Text = "● System Online"
SystemStatus.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
SystemStatus.TextSize = 11
SystemStatus.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(52, 199, 89)
SystemStatus.Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 8)
SystemStatus.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 16)
SystemStatus.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
SystemStatus.BackgroundTransparency = 1
SystemStatus.Parent = StatusCard

local PlayerLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
PlayerLabel.Text = "User: " .. LocalPlayer.DisplayName
PlayerLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
PlayerLabel.TextSize = 10
PlayerLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 195)
PlayerLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 54, 0, 28)
PlayerLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 16)
PlayerLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
PlayerLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
PlayerLabel.Parent = StatusCard

local PerfFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
PerfFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 50)
PerfFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
PerfFrame.Parent = HomePage

local FPSCard = Instance.new("Frame")
FPSCard.Size = UDim2.new(0.48, 0, 1, 0)
FPSCard.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 40)
FPSCard.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
FPSCard.Parent = PerfFrame

local FPSCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
FPSCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
FPSCorner.Parent = FPSCard

local FPSValue = Instance.new("TextLabel")
FPSValue.Text = "FPS: 60"
FPSValue.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
FPSValue.TextSize = 14
FPSValue.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FPSValue.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
FPSValue.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FPSValue.Parent = FPSCard

local PingCard = Instance.new("Frame")

local PingCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")

        lastTime = tick()
        pcall(function()
            local ping = math.floor(Stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["Data Ping"]:GetValue())

-- ==================== MAIN TAB ====================

AddToggle(MainTab, "Aimbot на маньяка", false, function(Value)

end)

AddToggle(MainTab, "Показывать FOV Круг", false, function(Value)

    FOVCircle.Visible = Value
end)

AddToggle(MainTab, "Auto-Shoot (Автовыстрел)", false, function(Value)
    _G.AutoShoot = Value
end)

AddButton(MainTab, "Телепорт к пистолету (Gun)", function()
    local gun = GetDroppedGun()
    if gun then
        local gunPart = gun:IsA("BasePart") and gun or gun:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if gunPart and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = gunPart.CFrame
        end
    end
end)

-- Main Loop (Aimbot & AutoShoot & FOV)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    FOVCircle.Position = screenCenter

    local murderer = GetMurderer()
    if murderer and murderer.Character and murderer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        local targetPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(murderer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
        local distFromCenter = (Vector2.new(targetPos.X, targetPos.Y) - screenCenter).Magnitude

        if _G.Aimbot and onScreen and distFromCenter <= FOVCircle.Radius then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, murderer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
        end

        -- Improved Auto-Shoot Logic
        if _G.AutoShoot and onScreen and distFromCenter <= FOVCircle.Radius then
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                local backpackGun = LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun")
                local charGun = char:FindFirstChild("Gun")

                if backpackGun then
                    char.Humanoid:EquipTool(backpackGun)
                end

                local activeGun = charGun or backpackGun
                if activeGun then
                    Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, murderer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
                    activeGun:Activate()
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ==================== PLAYER TAB ====================

UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
    if _G.InfJump and LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
    end
end)

AddToggle(PlayerPage, "Быстрый бег (Speed 32)", false, function(Value)
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = Value and 32 or 16
    end
end)

AddToggle(PlayerPage, "Высокий прыжок (Jump 80)", false, function(Value)
    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = Value and 80 or 50
    end
end)

-- ==================== VISUALS TAB ====================
_G.GunESP = false
_G.RoleESP = false
_G.Tracers = false
_G.Fullbright = false

local function ClearGunESP()
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj.Name == "AppleGunHighlight" then
            obj:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

AddToggle(VisualsPage, "ESP Пистолета (Желтый)", false, function(Value)
    _G.GunESP = Value
    if not Value then ClearGunESP() end
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.GunESP do
            task.wait(0.5)
            pcall(function()
                local gun = GetDroppedGun()
                if gun then
                    local gunPart = gun:IsA("BasePart") and gun or gun:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                    if gunPart and not gunPart:FindFirstChild("AppleGunHighlight") then
                        local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        highlight.Name = "AppleGunHighlight"
                        highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)
                        highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                        highlight.FillTransparency = 0.2
                        highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0
                        highlight.Parent = gunPart
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end)
end)

AddToggle(VisualsPage, "Tracer Lines (Линии к цели)", false, function(Value)
    _G.Tracers = Value
    if not Value then
        MurdererTracer.Visible = false
        GunTracer.Visible = false
    end
end)

-- Tracers Loop
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.Tracers then
        local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y)

        -- Tracer to Murderer
        local murderer = GetMurderer()
        if murderer and murderer.Character and murderer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(murderer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
            if onScreen then
                MurdererTracer.From = screenCenter
                MurdererTracer.To = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
                MurdererTracer.Visible = true
            else
                MurdererTracer.Visible = false
            end
        else
            MurdererTracer.Visible = false
        end

        -- Tracer to Dropped Gun
        local gun = GetDroppedGun()
        if gun then
            local gunPart = gun:IsA("BasePart") and gun or gun:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if gunPart then
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(gunPart.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    GunTracer.From = screenCenter
                    GunTracer.To = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
                    GunTracer.Visible = true
                else
                    GunTracer.Visible = false
                end
            else
                GunTracer.Visible = false
            end
        else
            GunTracer.Visible = false
        end
    end
end)

AddToggle(VisualsPage, "ESP Ролей (Убийца/Шериф/Игроки)", false, function(Value)
    _G.RoleESP = Value
    task.spawn(function()
        while _G.RoleESP do
            task.wait(1)
            for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                    local char = plr.Character
                    local highlight = char:FindFirstChild("RoleHighlight") or Instance.new("Highlight")
                    highlight.Name = "RoleHighlight"
                    highlight.Parent = char
                    
                    local isMurderer = plr.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Knife") or char:FindFirstChild("Knife")
                    local isSheriff = plr.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Gun") or char:FindFirstChild("Gun")
                    
                    if isMurderer then
                        highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
                    elseif isSheriff then
                        highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 255)
                    else
                        highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(50, 255, 100)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if not _G.RoleESP then
            for _, plr in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("RoleHighlight") then
                    plr.Character.RoleHighlight:Destroy()
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end)

scripts.author: FestinDev
scripts.description:
Как пользоваться
Шаг 1 — Найди path к нужному UI
В игре открой Explorer (через Dex Explorer или Simple Spy) и найди путь, например:

Что хочешь скопировать	Пример path
Весь ScreenGui	game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.ScreenGui
Конкретный Frame	game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.HUD.MainFrame
Кнопку	game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Shop.BuyButton
UI из CoreGui	game.CoreGui.RobloxGui
Шаг 2 — Вставь path в нужное поле
Поле	Что делает
🖥 ScreenGui Path	Копирует всё включая скрипты (LocalScript, ModuleScript) с декомпиляцией
🧩 Object Path	Копирует только UI элементы (Frame, Button и тд) без скриптов, но со всеми Properties
Шаг 3 — Нажми кнопку
Файл сохранится как CopyUI1.rbxmx, CopyUI2.rbxmx и тд в папку workspace эксплоита.

Шаг 4 — Импорт в Roblox Studio
Открой Roblox Studio
File → Import from File (или перетащи файл в окно)
Выбери CopyUI1.rbxmx
Все элементы появятся в Explorer — все свойства (Position, Size, Color, Transparency и тд) сохранены!

СЕРИАЛИЗАТОР -- ============================================ local function EscapeXML(str) if not str then return "" end str = tostring(str) str = str:gsub("&", "&") str = str:gsub("<", "<") str = str:gsub(">", ">") str = str:gsub("\"", """) str = str:gsub("'", "'") return str end local function Color3ToXML(c) return string.format("%f%f%f", c.R, c.G, c.B) end local function UDim2ToXML(u) return return table.concat(parts, " ") end local function ColorSequenceToXML(cs) local parts = {} for _, kp in ipairs(cs.Keypoints) do table.insert(parts, string.format("%f %f %f %f 0", kp.Time, kp.Value.R, kp.Value.G, kp.Value.B)) end return table.concat(parts, " ") end local function NumberRangeToXML(nr) return string.format("%f %f", nr.Min, nr.Max) end local function SerializeProperty(obj, propName) local success, value = pcall(function() return obj[propName] end) if not success or value == nil then return nil end local typ = typeof(value) if typ == "string" then return string.format('%s', propName, EscapeXML(value)) elseif typ == "number" then if math.floor(value) == value and math.abs(value) < 2^31 then return string.format('%d', propName, value) else return string.format('%f', propName, value) end elseif typ == "boolean" then return string.format('%s', propName, tostring(value)) elseif typ == "Color3" then return string.format('%s', propName, Color3ToXML(value)) elseif typ == "UDim2" then return string.format('%s', propName, UDim2ToXML(value)) elseif typ == "UDim" then return string.format('%s', propName, UDimToXML(value)) elseif typ == "Vector2" then return string.format('%s', propName, Vector2ToXML(value)) elseif typ == "Vector3" then return string.format('%s', propName, Vector3ToXML(value)) elseif typ == "Rect" then return string.format('%s', propName, RectToXML(value)) elseif typ == "NumberSequence" then return string.format('%s', propName, NumberSequenceToXML(value)) elseif typ == "ColorSequence" then return string.format('%s', propName, ColorSequenceToXML(value)) elseif typ == "NumberRange" then return string.format('%s', propName, NumberRangeToXML(value)) elseif typ == "EnumItem" then return string.format('%d', propName, value.Value) elseif typ == "Font" then -- Пробуем получить как обычный enum local ok, fontEnum = pcall(function() return obj.Font end) if ok and typeof(fontEnum) == "EnumItem" then return string.format('%d', fontEnum.Value) end end return nil end -- ============================================ -- 📚 РАСШИРЕННЫЙ СПИСОК СВОЙСТВ -- ============================================ -- Базовые GUI свойства (для всех Frame-подобных) local BaseGuiProps = { "Name", "Active", "AnchorPoint", "AutomaticSize", "BackgroundColor3", "BackgroundTransparency", "BorderColor3", "BorderSizePixel", "TextSize", "TextStrokeColor3", "TextStrokeTransparency", "TextTransparency", "TextTruncate", "TextWrapped", "TextXAlignment", "TextYAlignment" } -- Свойства изображения local ImageProps = { "Image", "TrackballRadialPullFactor", "TrackballRollFactor" }, -- СКРИПТЫ LocalScript = {"Name", "Enabled", "RunContext"}, Script = {"Name", "Enabled", "RunContext"}, ModuleScript = {"Name"}, -- КОНТЕЙНЕРЫ Folder = {"Name"}, Configuration = {"Name"}, -- ЗНАЧЕНИЯ (Value objects) StringValue = {"Name", "Value"}, IntValue = {"Name", "Value"}, NumberValue = {"Name", "Value"}, BoolValue = {"Name", "Value"}, ObjectValue = {"Name"}, Color3Value = {"Name", "Value"}, Vector3Value = {"Name", "Value"}, CFrameValue = {"Name"}, RayValue = {"Name"}, BrickColorValue = {"Name"}, -- SELECTION UISelectionModule = {"Name"}, } -- Список всех известных UI классов (для универсальной поддержки) local knownUIClasses = { ["UICorner"] = true, ["UIStroke"] = true, ["UIGradient"] = true, ["UIPadding"] = true, ["UIAspectRatioConstraint"] = true, ["UISizeConstraint"] = true, ["UITextSizeConstraint"] = true, ["UIScale"] = true, ["UIListLayout"] = true, ["UIGridLayout"] = true, ["UIPageLayout"] = true, ["UITableLayout"] = true, ["UIFlexItem"] = true, ["UIDragDetector"] = true } local function GetScriptSource(scriptObj) local source = nil pcall(function() if decompile then source = decompile(scriptObj) end end) if source then return source end pcall(function() if getsourcecode then source = getsourcecode(scriptObj) end end) if source then return source end pcall(function() source = scriptObj.Source end) if source and source ~= "" then return source end return "-- [Nebula Ripper] Could not decompile: " .. scriptObj:GetFullName() end -- SerializeInstance(obj, indent) indent = indent or 1 local tabs = string.rep("\t", indent) local className = obj.ClassName if obj.Name == "UIRipperGui" then return "" end -- Пропускаем скрипты если включен режим "без скриптов" if skipScripts and (className == "LocalScript" or className == "Script" or className == "ModuleScript") then return "" end local xml = {} table.insert(xml, tabs .. string.format('', className, tostring(math.random(100000000, 999999999)))) table.insert(xml, tabs .. "\t") local props = classProperties[className] if props then -- Используем предопределённый список свойств for _, propName in ipairs(props) do local serialized = SerializeProperty(obj, propName) if serialized then table.insert(xml, tabs .. "\t\t" .. serialized) end end else -- Автоматическое определение для неизвестных классов -- Пробуем все базовые GUI свойства for _, propName in ipairs(BaseGuiProps) do local serialized = SerializeProperty(obj, propName) if serialized then table.insert(xml, tabs .. "") return table.concat(xml, "\n") end local function SerializeToRBXMX(obj, noScripts) objectCount = 0 skipScripts = noScripts or false local xml = { '', '\ttrue', } objectCount = objectCount + 1 table.insert(xml, SerializeInstance(obj, 1)) table.insert(xml, '') return table.concat(xml, "\n"), objectCount end -- ============================================ -- ИНТЕРФЕЙС GUI -- MainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui AddCorner(MainFrame, 18) local MainStroke = AddStroke(MainFrame, Color3.fromRGB(80, 50, 200), 2, 0) local StrokeGrad = MainFrame.Parent do for i = 0, 360, 1.5 do if not MainFrame or not MainFrame.Parent then break end StrokeGrad.Rotation = i task.wait(0.025) end end end) -- Свечение сверху local TopGlow = ============================================ -- SMART PATH RESOLVER -- ============================================ local function ResolvePath(pathStr) pathStr = pathStr:gsub("GetService%s*%(%s*['\"](%w+)['\"]%s*%)", "%1") pathStr = pathStr:gsub(":", ".") pathStr = pathStr:gsub("%(%s*%)", "") local parts = {} for part in pathStr:gmatch("[^%.]+") do part = part:gsub("['\"]", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if part ~= "" then table.insert(parts, part) end end if #parts == 0 then return nil, "Пустой путь" end local current = nil if parts[1] == "game" then current = game table.remove(parts, 1) elseif parts[1] == "workspace" or parts[1] == "Workspace" then current = workspace table.remove(parts, 1) else current = game end for _, part in ipairs(parts) do local found = nil local success = pcall(function() found = current:FindFirstChild(part) end) if not success or not found then pcall(function() found = current[part] end) end if not found and current == game then pcall(function() found = game:GetService(part) end) end if not found then return nil, "Не найден: '" .. part .. "' в " .. tostring(current) end current = found end return current, nil end -- ============================================ -- ПОДСЧЁТ ТИПОВ ОБЪЕКТОВ -- ============================================ local function CountObjectTypes(obj) local counts = { Total = 0, UI = 0, Effects = 0, Scripts = 0, Other = 0 } local function scan(o) counts.Total = counts.Total + 1 local class = o.ClassName if knownUIClasses[class] then counts.Effects = counts.Effects + 1 elseif class == "LocalScript" or class == "Script" or class == "ModuleScript" then counts.Scripts = counts.Scripts + 1 elseif class:find("Frame") or class:find("Label") or class:find("Button") or class:find("Image") or class == "ScreenGui" or class == "ScrollingFrame" then counts.UI = counts.UI + 1 else counts.Other = counts.Other + 1 end for _, child in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do scan(child) end end scan(obj) return counts end -- ============================================ -- ЛОГИКА КНОПОК -- ============================================ local isCopying = false local function DoCopy(path, withScripts, btn, btnText, defaultText) if isCopying then return end isCopying = true if path == "" then ShowStatus(false, "❌ Ошибка", "Заполните поле пути", "", "") isCopying = false return end btnText.Text = "⏳ КОПИРОВАНИЕ..." task.wait(0.1) local obj, err = ResolvePath(path) if not obj then ShowStatus(false, "❌ Объект не найден", err, "Проверьте путь", "") btnText.Text = defaultText isCopying = false return end -- Считаем что копируем local counts = CountObjectTypes(obj) local success, xmlData = pcall(function() return SerializeToRBXMX(obj, not withScripts) end) if not success then ShowStatus(false, "❌ Ошибка конвертации", tostring(xmlData), "", "") btnText.Text = defaultText isCopying = false return end copyCounter = copyCounter + 1 local fileName = "CopyUI" .. tostring(copyCounter) .. ".rbxmx" local ok, writeErr = pcall(function() writefile(fileName, xmlData) end) if ok then local scriptsInfo = withScripts and ("Scripts: " .. counts.Scripts) or "Scripts: removed" ShowStatus(true, "✅ Успешно скопировано!", "📁 File: workspace/" .. fileName, "🎨 UI: " .. counts.UI .. " | ✨ Effects: " .. counts.Effects .. " | 📜 " .. scriptsInfo, "Total objects: " .. counts.Total ) else ShowStatus(false, "❌ Ошибка записи", tostring(writeErr), "Эксплоит не поддерживает writefile", "") end btnText.Text = defaultText isCopying = false end CopyScreenGuiBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() DoCopy(ScreenGuiInput.Text, true, CopyScreenGuiFrame, CopyScreenGuiText, "🖥 COPY WITH SCRIPTS") end) CopyObjectBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() DoCopy(ObjectInput.Text, false, CopyObjectFrame, CopyObjectText, "🧩 COPY WITHOUT SCRIPTS") end) -- Footer local Footer = Instance.new("Frame") Footer.Size = UDim2.new(0.92, 0, 0, 24) Footer.Position = UDim2.new(0.04, 0, 1, -32) Footer.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 24) Footer.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4 Footer.Parent = MainFrame AddCorner(Footer, 8) local FooterText = Instance.new("TextLabel") FooterText.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0) FooterText.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 0) FooterText.BackgroundTransparency = 1 FooterText.Text = "✨ v1.2 — Все UI эффекты копируются полностью" FooterText.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 110) FooterText.TextSize = 9 FooterText.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham FooterText.Parent = Footer print("============================================") print("🔧 NEBULA UI Ripper v1.2 — Loaded!") print(" ✨ Full support: UIStroke, UICorner, UIGradient") print(" ✨ UIPadding, UIListLayout, UIGridLayout") print(" ✨ UIAspectRatioConstraint, UIFlexItem и др.") print("============================================")

--[[ Frizi Single-Point Auto Clicker
     Кликает всегда в одну точку экрана. Курсор не смещается.
]]

local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RS  = game:GetService("RunService")
local CG  = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local T   = game:GetService("TweenService")

-- =========================================================
-- НАСТРОЙКИ
-- =========================================================
local ClickX = 0.5        -- 0..1 (0 = левый край, 0.5 = центр, 1 = правый)
local ClickY = 0.5        -- 0..1 (0 = верх, 0.5 = центр, 1 = низ)
local CPS    = 10         -- кликов в секунду
local Bind   = Enum.KeyCode.F
local Clicking = false
local SettingBind = false
local TotalClicks = 0

-- =========================================================
-- ЗАФИКСИРОВАТЬ КУРСОР В ЦЕНТРЕ
-- =========================================================
-- Если MouseBehavior = LockCenter, курсор всегда в центре экрана и НЕ двигается.
-- Клики идут в центр окна. Если хочешь кликать не в центре — см. пояснение ниже.
UIS.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter

-- =========================================================
-- ФУНКЦИЯ КЛИКА В ФИКСИРОВАННУЮ ТОЧКУ
-- =========================================================
local function ClickAtFixedPoint()
    -- Вариант 1: через VirtualInputManager (клик в абсолютную точку экрана)
    local VIM = game:GetService("VirtualInputManager")
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local vp = cam.ViewportSize
    local x = math.floor(vp.X * ClickX)
    local y = math.floor(vp.Y * ClickY)
    VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 1)   -- нажатие
    task.wait(0.01)
    VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1)  -- отпускание
end

-- Альтернатива через mouse1click (без указания координат — клик в текущую позицию курсора,
-- а так как курсор зафиксирован в центре — это всегда одна точка):
local function ClickSimple()
    if mouse1click then mouse1click() end
end

-- =========================================================
-- UI
-- =========================================================
if CG:FindFirstChild("Frizi_Clicker") then CG.Frizi_Clicker:Destroy() end

local SG = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
SG.Name = "Frizi_Clicker"
SG.ResetOnSpawn = false
SG.Parent = CG

local Main = Instance.new("Frame", SG)
Main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 260)
Main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.5, -130)
Main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 15)
Main.Active = true
Main.Draggable = true
Instance.new("UICorner", Main).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local Stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", Main)
Stroke.Thickness = 2
Stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 180)

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel", Main)
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
Title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Title.Text = "FRIZI CLICKER"
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
Title.TextSize = 18
Title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

-- Кнопка закрытия
local CB = Instance.new("TextButton", Main)
CB.Size = UDim2.new(0, 25, 0, 25)
CB.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0, 8)
CB.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
CB.Text = "X"
CB.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
CB.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
Instance.new("UICorner", CB).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
CB.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() SG:Destroy() end)

-- Поле CPS
local CPSBox = Instance.new("TextBox", Main)
CPSBox.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 35)
CPSBox.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0, 50)
CPSBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 25)
CPSBox.Text = tostring(CPS)
CPSBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
CPSBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
CPSBox.TextSize = 14
Instance.new("UICorner", CPSBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
CPSBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    local v = tonumber(CPSBox.Text)
    if v then CPS = math.clamp(v, 1, 2000) CPSBox.Text = tostring(CPS) end
end)

-- Кнопка START/STOP

-- ARTEM HUB • v25 — TABS + INVIS + ESP + FLY + MOVEMENTS
local Players    = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS        = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local lplr       = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera     = workspace.CurrentCamera

local STUDS = 16000

local S = {
    InvisOn = false, Cpart = nil, OldY = 0, OldPos = nil, Conn = nil, Up = 0,
    EspOn   = false, EspHls = {}, EspAdd = nil, EspRem = nil,
    FlyOn   = false, FlyConn = nil, FlySpeed = 120,
    FlyUpBtn = false, FlyDownBtn = false, BodyPos = nil, BodyGyro = nil,
    Speed   = 16,
    Jump    = 50,
    NoclipOn = false, NoclipConn = nil, NoclipBackup = {},
}

--============================================================
--  INVIS
--============================================================
function _G.invis()
    S.InvisOn = not S.InvisOn
    if S.InvisOn then
        local char = lplr.Character
        if not char then S.InvisOn = false return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then S.InvisOn = false return end
        S.OldY = hrp.Position.Y; S.OldPos = hrp.CFrame; S.Up = 0
        S.Cpart = Instance.new("Part")
        S.Cpart.Anchored = true; S.Cpart.CanCollide = false
        S.Cpart.CanQuery = false; S.Cpart.CanTouch = false
        S.Cpart.Transparency = 1; S.Cpart.Size = Vector3.new(0.1,0.1,0.1)
        S.Cpart.CFrame = CFrame.new(S.OldPos.Position); S.Cpart.Parent = Camera
        hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(S.OldPos.Position + Vector3.new(0, STUDS, 0))
        Camera.CameraSubject = S.Cpart
        S.Conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local c = lplr.Character; if not c then return end
            local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not r then return end
            if S.Cpart then S.Cpart.Position = Vector3.new(r.Position.X, S.OldY + S.Up, r.Position.Z) end
            if r.Position.Y <= (S.OldY + 4) then r.CFrame = r.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, STUDS, 0) end
            if UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then S.Up = S.Up + 0.3
            elseif UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then S.Up = S.Up - 0.3 end
            local v = r.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z)
        end)
    else
        if S.Conn then S.Conn:Disconnect() S.Conn = nil end
        local char = lplr.Character
        if char then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local r = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum then Camera.CameraSubject = hum end
            if r then r.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.Position.X, S.OldY + 3, r.Position.Z) end
        end
        if S.Cpart then S.Cpart:Destroy() S.Cpart = nil end
    end
end

--============================================================
--  ESP
--============================================================
local ESP_COLOR = Color3.fromHex("#39FF88")
local function makeESP(plr)
    if plr == lplr or S.EspHls[plr] then return end
    local char = plr.Character; if not char then return end
    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.Name = "ARTEM_ESP"; hl.Adornee = char
    hl.FillColor = ESP_COLOR; hl.FillTransparency = 0.75
    hl.OutlineColor = ESP_COLOR; hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
    hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    hl.Parent = char; S.EspHls[plr] = hl
end
local function removeESP(plr)
    local hl = S.EspHls[plr]; if hl then hl:Destroy() end; S.EspHls[plr] = nil
end
local function refreshESP()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= lplr then
            if S.EspOn then makeESP(p) else removeESP(p) end
        end
    end
end
function _G.esp()
    S.EspOn = not S.EspOn
    if S.EspOn then
        refreshESP()
        S.EspAdd = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p) if S.EspOn then task.wait(0.5) makeESP(p) end end)
        S.EspRem = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(removeESP)
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= lplr then p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() if S.EspOn then task.wait(0.3) makeESP(p) end end) end
        end
    else
        if S.EspAdd then S.EspAdd:Disconnect() S.EspAdd = nil end
        if S.EspRem then S.EspRem:Disconnect() S.EspRem = nil end
        for plr in pairs(S.EspHls) do removeESP(plr) end
    end
end

--============================================================
--  FLY
--============================================================
function _G.fly()
    S.FlyOn = not S.FlyOn
    if S.FlyOn then
        local char = lplr.Character
        if not char then S.FlyOn = false return end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then S.FlyOn = false return end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.PlatformStand = true end

        S.BodyPos = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
        S.BodyPos.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        S.BodyPos.P = 10000; S.BodyPos.D = 500
        S.BodyPos.Position = hrp.Position; S.BodyPos.Parent = hrp

        S.BodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        S.BodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
        S.BodyGyro.P = 10000; S.BodyGyro.D = 500
        S.BodyGyro.CFrame = hrp.CFrame; S.BodyGyro.Parent = hrp

        S.FlyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
            local c = lplr.Character; if not c then return end
            local r = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not r then return end
            local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if not h then return end
            local speed = S.FlySpeed
            local vel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            local moveDir = h.MoveDirection
            if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then vel = moveDir * speed end
            local vy = 0
            if S.FlyUpBtn or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then vy = vy + 1 end
            if S.FlyDownBtn or UIS:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then vy = vy - 1 end
            if vel.Magnitude == 0 and vy == 0 then
                if S.BodyPos then S.BodyPos.Position = r.Position end
                r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
                r.Velocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
                r.RotVelocity = Vector3.new(0,0,0)
            else
                local newPos = r.Position + Vector3.new(vel.X, vy*speed*0.6, vel.Z) * dt
                if S.BodyPos then S.BodyPos.Position = newPos end
                r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, vy*speed*0.6, vel.Z)
            end
        end)
    else
        if S.FlyConn then S.FlyConn:Disconnect() S.FlyConn = nil end
        if S.BodyPos then S.BodyPos:Destroy() S.BodyPos = nil end
        if S.BodyGyro then S.BodyGyro:Destroy() S.BodyGyro = nil end
        local char = lplr.Character
        if char then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local r = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
            if r then
                local ray = Ray.new(r.Position, Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0))
                local hit, pos = workspace:FindPartOnRay(ray, char)
                if hit and pos then r.CFrame = CFrame.new(r.Position.X, pos.Y + 3, r.Position.Z) end
            end
        end
    end
end

function _G.setSpeed(v)
    S.Speed = v
    local char = lplr.Character

function _G.setJump(v)
    S.Jump = v

function _G.noclip()
    S.NoclipOn = not S.NoclipOn
    if S.NoclipOn then
        S.NoclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            local char = lplr.Character
            if not char then return end
            for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
                if d:IsA("BasePart") and d.CanCollide then
                    S.NoclipBackup[d] = true
                    d.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end)
    else
        if S.NoclipConn then S.NoclipConn:Disconnect() S.NoclipConn = nil end
        for obj in pairs(S.NoclipBackup) do
            if typeof(obj) == "Instance" and obj.Parent then
                pcall(function() obj.CanCollide = true end)
            end
        end
        table.clear(S.NoclipBackup)
    end
end

local function makeSlider(parent, y, min, max, init, onChange)
    local bg = Instance.new("Frame")

    bg.BackgroundColor3 = GREEN_SOFT; bg.BorderSizePixel = 0

    local fill = Instance.new("Frame")

    fill.BackgroundColor3 = GREEN; fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    fill.Parent = bg
    Instance.new("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

    local knob = Instance.new("TextButton")
    knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 16)
    knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, -8, 0.5, -8)
    knob.BackgroundColor3 = GREEN; knob.Text = ""
    knob.BorderSizePixel = 0; knob.Parent = bg
    Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local dragging = false
    local function setPercent(p)
        p = math.clamp(p, 0, 1)
        local v = math.floor(min + (max - min) * p)
        fill.Size = UDim2.new(p, 0, 1, 0)
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(p, -8, 0.5, -8)
        onChange(v)
        return v
    end
    local function process(input)
        local pos = input.Position.X - bg.AbsolutePosition.X
        setPercent(pos / bg.AbsoluteSize.X)
    end
    knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true
        end
    end)
    bg.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = true; process(i)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
            process(i)
        end
    end)
    UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    setPercent((init - min) / (max - min))
    return bg
end

            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
        end
    end

-- Target Selector для Аимбота
local function GetClosestPlayer()
    local closestTarget = nil
    local shortestDist = math.huge
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character then
            local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local rootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and rootPart then
                local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(rootPart.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local dist = (Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y) - Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X/2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y/2)).Magnitude
                    if dist < shortestDist then
                        shortestDist = dist
                        closestTarget = rootPart
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return closestTarget
end

-- Главный цикл (RenderStepped) для бесперебойного ВХ и Аимбота
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    -- Ультимативный Wallhack (автоматически создает/обновляет подсветку для всех игроков)
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local char = player.Character
            if char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                local hl = char:FindFirstChild("BS_WH")
                if WallhackEnabled then
                    if not hl then
                        hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                        hl.Name = "BS_WH"
                        hl.Adornee = char
                        hl.FillTransparency = 0.4
                        hl.OutlineTransparency = 0
                        hl.Parent = char
                    end
                    hl.FillColor = WallhackColor
                    hl.OutlineColor = WallhackColor
                    hl.Enabled = true
                else
                    if hl then
                        hl.Enabled = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Aimbot Logic
    if AimbotEnabled then
        local target = GetClosestPlayer()
        if target then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, target.Position)
        end
    end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local roleColors = {

	["Agent"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 230, 0),
	["Hacker"] = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 50),
	["Barber"] = Color3.fromRGB(0, 195, 255),
	["Party Pooper"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 0)
}

local defaultColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

-- Получение только информации о роли игрока
local function getRoleInfo(character)
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid then return nil, defaultColor end

	local roleValue = humanoid:FindFirstChild("Role") or character:FindFirstChild("Role")
	if roleValue and roleValue.Value ~= "" then
		local roleName = tostring(roleValue.Value)
		local roleColor = roleColors[roleName] or defaultColor
		return roleName, roleColor
	end

	return nil, defaultColor
end

-- Применение подсветки только к персонажу
local function updateHighlight(character, color, enabled)
	local highlight = character:FindFirstChild("ESPHighlight")
	if not highlight then
		highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
		highlight.Name = "ESPHighlight"
		highlight.FillTransparency = 0.4
		highlight.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
		highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
		highlight.Parent = character
	end

	highlight.Enabled = enabled
	highlight.FillColor = color
end

-- Создание только имени и роли над головой
local function updateNameTag(character, playerName, roleName, color, enabled)
	local gui = character:FindFirstChild("ESPNameTag")
	if not gui then
		gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		gui.Name = "ESPNameTag"
		gui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
		gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
		gui.MaxDistance = MAX_DISTANCE
		gui.Parent = character

		local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		label.Name = "TagLabel"
		label.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
		label.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		label.TextScaled = true
		label.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
		label.Parent = gui
	end

	gui.Enabled = enabled
	local label = gui:FindFirstChild("TagLabel")
	if label then
		label.Text = playerName .. "\n[" .. (roleName or "Unknown") .. "]"
		label.TextColor3 = color
	end
end

-- Глобальный постоянный цикл проверки
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
	local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player ~= LocalPlayer then
			local char = player.Character
			local targetRoot = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local humanoid = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if char and targetRoot and humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local inRange = true
				if myRoot then
					local distance = (myRoot.Position - targetRoot.Position).Magnitude
					inRange = distance <= MAX_DISTANCE
				end

				local roleName, roleColor = getRoleInfo(char)
				updateHighlight(char, roleColor, inRange)
				updateNameTag(char, player.Name, roleName, roleColor, inRange)
			end
		end
	end
end)

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local PG = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local Config = {
    Enabled = false,
    Mode = "Me",            -- "Me" | "Closest" | "All" | "Selected"
    SelectedPlayer = nil,   -- ник выбранного игрока
    Radius = 500,
    Cooldown = 0.3,
    Blacklist = {"Baseplate", "SpawnLocation", "Terrain", "Camera", "Humanoid"}
}

local function FindItems()
    local char = LP.Character
    if not char then return {} end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp then return {} end
    local found = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj ~= hrp and not obj.Anchored then
            local isChar = false
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr.Character and plr.Character:IsAncestorOf(obj) then
                    isChar = true; break
                end
            end
            if not isChar then
                local ok = true
                for _, name in ipairs(Config.Blacklist) do
                    if obj.Name:find(name) then ok = false; break end
                end
                if ok and (obj.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude <= Config.Radius then
                    table.insert(found, obj)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return found
end

local function GetTarget()
    if Config.Mode == "Me" then
        local c = LP.Character
        return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    elseif Config.Mode == "Closest" then
        local c = LP.Character
        if not c then return nil end
        local hrp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local closest, minD = nil, math.huge
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                local ph = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if ph then
                    local d = (ph.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < minD then minD = d; closest = ph end
                end
            end
        end
        return closest
    elseif Config.Mode == "Selected" and Config.SelectedPlayer then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Name == Config.SelectedPlayer and p.Character then
                return p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            end
        end
    end
    return nil
end

    while task.wait(Config.Cooldown) do
        if not Config.Enabled then continue end
        pcall(function()
            local items = FindItems()
            if Config.Mode == "All" then

                    if p ~= LP and p.Character then

                        if hrp then

                for _, item in ipairs(items) do
