                end
            end
        end)
    end

-- Scan for tycoon bases/pads that don't belong to LocalPlayer
local function findEnemyBase()
    -- Common tycoon folder names
    local searchTerms = {"Tycoon", "Base", "Plot", "Factory"}
    local enemyBases = {}

    for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        for _, term in pairs(searchTerms) do
            if string.find(obj.Name, term, 1, true) then
                -- Check if it's a model or folder containing tycoon stuff
                if obj:IsA("Model") or obj:IsA("Folder") then
                    -- Try to find owner info
                    local ownerVal = obj:FindFirstChild("Owner") or obj:FindFirstChild("OwnerName")
                    if ownerVal then
                        local ownerName = nil
                        if ownerVal:IsA("ObjectValue") and ownerVal.Value then
                            ownerName = ownerVal.Value.Name
                        elseif ownerVal:IsA("StringValue") then
                            ownerName = ownerVal.Value
                        end
                        if ownerName and ownerName ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
                            table.insert(enemyBases, obj)
                        end
                    else
                        -- No owner = unclaimed or enemy
                        table.insert(enemyBases, obj)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    -- Find closest mob to any enemy base or just find center of enemy base
    if #enemyBases > 0 then
        local base = enemyBases[1]
        -- Find the primary part or center
        local target = base.PrimaryPart or base:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
        if target then
            return target.Position
        end
    end
    return nil
end

--═══════════════════════════════════
-- FEATURES
--═══════════════════════════════════

-- ▸ FLY
createToggle("Fly", "🕊️",
    function()
        flying = true
        bodyVel = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
        bodyVel.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
        bodyVel.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        bodyVel.Parent = rootPart

        bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
        bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
        bodyGyro.P = 9e4
        bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart

        storeConn("fly", RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not flying or not rootPart.Parent then return end
            local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            local moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection

            local flyVec = Vector3.zero
            if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
                flyVec = cam.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(moveDir)
            end
            if humanoid.Jump then
                flyVec = flyVec + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            end

            bodyVel.Velocity = flyVec * 90
            bodyGyro.CFrame = cam.CFrame
        end))
    end,
    function()
        flying = false
        if connections["fly"] then connections["fly"]:Disconnect() end
        if bodyVel then bodyVel:Destroy() bodyVel = nil end
        if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end
    end
)

-- ▸ SPEED HACK
createToggle("Speed Hack", "🏃",
    function()
        storeConn("speed", RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = 120
            end
        end))
    end,
    function()
        if connections["speed"] then connections["speed"]:Disconnect() end
        if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16 end
    end
)

-- ▸ AUTO KILL MOBS (proximity-based — walk near them, they die)
createToggle("Auto Kill Mobs (Proximity)", "⚔️",
    function()
        autoKill = true
        storeConn("autokill", RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not autoKill then return end

            local myPos = rootPart.Position
            local KILL_RADIUS = 35 -- studs, walk near = they die

            local mobs = findMobs()
            for _, mob in pairs(mobs) do
                if mob.humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local dist = (mob.rootPart.Position - myPos).Magnitude
                    if dist <= KILL_RADIUS then
                        -- Teleport to mob momentarily to trigger hit, then kill
                        mob.humanoid.Health = 0
                        -- Also try common damage methods
                        pcall(function()
                            mob.humanoid:TakeDamage(9999)
                        end)
                        pcall(function()
                            mob.charModel:BreakJoints()
                        end)
                    end
                end
            end
        end))
    end,
    function()
        autoKill = false
        if connections["autokill"] then connections["autokill"]:Disconnect() end
    end
)

-- ▸ GO TO ENEMY BASE (teleport there safely)
createToggle("Go to Enemy Base", "🏯",
    function()
        goToBase = true
        storeConn("enemybase", RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not goToBase then return end

            -- godmode while traveling (so we don't die on the way)
            if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                humanoid.MaxHealth = 999999
                humanoid.Health = 999999
            end

            local enemyPos = findEnemyBase()
            if enemyPos then
                -- hover above the base to stay safe
                rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(enemyPos + Vector3.new(0, 30, 0))
            end
        end))
    end,
    function()
        goToBase = false
        if connections["enemybase"] then connections["enemybase"]:Disconnect() end
        -- restore health settings
        if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
            humanoid.MaxHealth = 100
        end
    end
)

-- ▸ GOD MODE (always survive)
createToggle("God Mode", "🛡️",
    function()
        storeConn("godmode", RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                humanoid.MaxHealth = 999999
                humanoid.Health = 999999
                humanoid.WalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed -- keep speed normal unless speed hack active
            end
        end))

        -- also disable fall damage / death states
        storeConn("godmode2", RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
            if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                pcall(function()
                    humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
                end)
            end
        end))
    end,
    function()
        if connections["godmode"] then connections["godmode"]:Disconnect() end
        if connections["godmode2"] then connections["godmode2"]:Disconnect() end
        if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
            humanoid.MaxHealth = 100
            humanoid.Health = 100
        end
    end
)

-- ▸ KILL AURA (wider radius kill everything nearby)
createToggle("Kill Aura (Wide)", "💀",
    function()
        storeConn("killaura", RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local myPos = rootPart.Position
            local RADIUS = 80

            for _, obj in pairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                if obj:IsA("Humanoid") and obj.Health > 0 and obj.Parent ~= character then
                    local isPlayer = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj.Parent)
                    if not isPlayer then
                        local hrp = obj.Parent:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or obj.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
                        if hrp and (hrp.Position - myPos).Magnitude <= RADIUS then
                            obj.Health = 0
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end))
    end,
    function()
        if connections["killaura"] then connections["killaura"]:Disconnect() end
    end
)

--═══════════════════════════════════
-- CLOSE
--═══════════════════════════════════
CloseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, conn in pairs(connections) do
        conn:Disconnect()
    end
    if bodyVel then bodyVel:Destroy() end
    if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() end
    ScreenGui:Destroy()
end)

scripts.code:
-- ARTEM HUB • MOB MENU (Mobile Delta Edition)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
while not LocalPlayer do
    task.wait()
    LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
end

-- Безопасный родитель интерфейса
local SafeParent = (gethui and gethui()) or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5) or game:GetService("CoreGui")

local Old = SafeParent:FindFirstChild("ArtemHubCleanUI")
if Old then Old:Destroy() end

local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "ArtemHubCleanUI"
ScreenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ScreenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
ScreenGui.Parent = SafeParent

-- Цветовая схема
local THEME = {
    Bg = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16),
    Card = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24),
    Red = Color3.fromRGB(255, 45, 65),
    RedDim = Color3.fromRGB(120, 20, 35),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(225, 225, 235),
    Muted = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 145),
    Off = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
}

local Settings = {
    -- ESP
    ESP_Enabled = false,
    ESP_Highlights = true,
    ESP_Health = true,
    ESP_Distance = true,
    -- Movement
    Noclip = false,
    Fly = false,
    SpeedEnabled = false,
    SpeedValue = 16,
    -- Visual
    NightSky = false,
    MapBrightness = 0
}

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
-- ФУНКЦИОНАЛ: MOVEMENT (FLY, NOCLIP, SPEED)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════

-- Noclip
RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if Settings.Noclip and LocalPlayer.Character then
        pcall(function()
            for _, part in ipairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then
                    part.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- Fly (Мобильный полет)
local flyBV, flyBG, flyConn = nil, nil, nil
local function SetFly(enabled)
    Settings.Fly = enabled
    pcall(function()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

        if enabled and hrp and hum then
            flyBV = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            flyBV.MaxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
            flyBV.Parent = hrp

            flyBG = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
            flyBG.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
            flyBG.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
            flyBG.Parent = hrp

            hum.PlatformStand = true

            if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect() end
            flyConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                if Settings.Fly and char and hrp and hum and cam then
                    flyBG.CFrame = cam.CFrame
                    if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                        flyBV.Velocity = cam.CFrame.LookVector * (Settings.SpeedValue > 20 and Settings.SpeedValue or 50)
                    else
                        flyBV.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
                    end
                end
            end)
        else
            if flyConn then flyConn:Disconnect(); flyConn = nil end
            if flyBV then flyBV:Destroy(); flyBV = nil end
            if flyBG then flyBG:Destroy(); flyBG = nil end
            if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
        end
    end)
end

-- Speed
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    if Settings.SpeedEnabled and LocalPlayer.Character then
        pcall(function()
            local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = Settings.SpeedValue end
        end)
    end
end)

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
-- ФУНКЦИОНАЛ: VISUAL
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
local origClock = 14
pcall(function() origClock = Lighting.ClockTime end)

local function UpdateVisuals()
    pcall(function()
        if Settings.NightSky then
            Lighting.ClockTime = 0
        else
            Lighting.ClockTime = origClock
        end

        local factor = Settings.MapBrightness / 100
        Lighting.Brightness = 1 + (3 * factor)
        local val = math.floor(120 + 135 * factor)
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(val, val, val)
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(val, val, val)
    end)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
-- ФУНКЦИОНАЛ: ESP
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
local ESP_Table = {}

local function ClearESP(plr)
    if ESP_Table[plr] then
        pcall(function()
            if ESP_Table[plr].H then ESP_Table[plr].H:Destroy() end
            if ESP_Table[plr].B then ESP_Table[plr].B:Destroy() end
        end)
        ESP_Table[plr] = nil
    end
end

local function MakeESP(plr)
    if plr == LocalPlayer then return end
    ClearESP(plr)

    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return end
    local head = char:WaitForChild("Head", 2)
    local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 2)
    if not head or not hum then return end

    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.Adornee = char
    hl.FillColor = THEME.Red
    hl.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    hl.FillTransparency = 0.65
    hl.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
    hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    hl.Enabled = Settings.ESP_Enabled and Settings.ESP_Highlights
    hl.Parent = char

    local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    bb.Adornee = head
    bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 130, 0, 22)
    bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
    bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
    bb.Enabled = Settings.ESP_Enabled
    bb.Parent = head

    local txt = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    txt.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    txt.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    txt.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    txt.TextSize = 10
    txt.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
    txt.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
    txt.Parent = bb

    ESP_Table[plr] = {H = hl, B = bb, T = txt, Hum = hum, Head = head}
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.12)
        if Settings.ESP_Enabled then
            pcall(function()
                local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                local myHRP = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                for plr, d in pairs(ESP_Table) do
                    if d.B and d.B.Parent and d.T and d.Hum and d.Head then
                        local parts = {}
                        if Settings.ESP_Health then
                            table.insert(parts, math.floor(d.Hum.Health) .. " HP")
                        end
                        if Settings.ESP_Distance and myHRP then
                            local dist = math.floor((d.Head.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude)
                            table.insert(parts, dist .. "m")
                        end
                        d.T.Text = table.concat(parts, " · ")
                        d.H.Enabled = Settings.ESP_Highlights
                        d.B.Enabled = (#parts > 0)
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if p ~= LocalPlayer then
        p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() MakeESP(p) end)
        if p.Character then MakeESP(p) end
    end
end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
    p.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() MakeESP(p) end)
end)
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(ClearESP)

local function RefreshESP()
    for _, d in pairs(ESP_Table) do
        pcall(function()
            if d.H then d.H.Enabled = Settings.ESP_Enabled and Settings.ESP_Highlights end
            if d.B then d.B.Enabled = Settings.ESP_Enabled end
        end)
    end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
-- ПЕРЕМЕЩЕНИЕ ЭЛЕМЕНТОВ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
local function MakeDraggable(obj, handle)
    handle = handle or obj
    local dragging, dragStart, startPos = false, nil, nil
    handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = obj.Position
        end
    end)
    handle.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            dragging = false
        end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            local delta = input.Position - dragStart
            obj.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
        end
    end)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
-- ИНТЕРФЕЙС ARTEM HUB
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════

-- Кнопка [A]
local FloatBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
FloatBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40)
FloatBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0.45, 0)
FloatBtn.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Bg
FloatBtn.Text = "A"
FloatBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Red
FloatBtn.TextSize = 15
FloatBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
FloatBtn.Parent = ScreenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", FloatBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local fStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", FloatBtn)

MakeDraggable(FloatBtn)

-- Окно меню
local Menu = Instance.new("Frame")

Menu.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -115, 0.5, -120)
Menu.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Bg
Menu.Visible = false
Menu.ClipsDescendants = true
Menu.Parent = ScreenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", Menu).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
local mStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", Menu)
mStroke.Color = THEME.Red
mStroke.Thickness = 1

-- Шапка с новым названием
local Header = Instance.new("Frame")
Header.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
Header.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Header.Parent = Menu

local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0)
Title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)

Title.TextColor3 = THEME.Red

Title.TextSize = 9.5

MakeDraggable(Menu, Header)

-- Панель вкладок
local TabBar = Instance.new("Frame")

TabBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 32)
TabBar.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Card
TabBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
TabBar.Parent = Menu
Instance.new("UICorner", TabBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local TabList = Instance.new("UIListLayout", TabBar)
TabList.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
TabList.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

-- Страницы
local Pages = Instance.new("Frame")
Pages.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -62)
Pages.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 62)
Pages.BackgroundTransparency = 1
Pages.Parent = Menu

local function CreatePage()
    local page = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
    page.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    page.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    page.ScrollBarThickness = 0
    page.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
    page.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
    page.Visible = false
    page.Parent = Pages

    local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout", page)
    list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
    list.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
    list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

    local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", page)
    pad.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, 2)
    pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 4)
    return page
end

local Page_ESP = CreatePage()
local Page_Movement = CreatePage()
local Page_Visual = CreatePage()

local tabs = {}
local function AddTab(name, page, order)
    local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    btn.Size = UDim2.new(0.333, 0, 1, 0)
    btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    btn.Text = name
    btn.TextColor3 = THEME.Muted
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    btn.TextSize = 9
    btn.LayoutOrder = order
    btn.Parent = TabBar

    tabs[name] = {Btn = btn, Page = page}

    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        for _, t in pairs(tabs) do
            t.Page.Visible = false
            t.Btn.TextColor3 = THEME.Muted
        end
        page.Visible = true
        btn.TextColor3 = THEME.Red
    end)
end

AddTab("ESP", Page_ESP, 1)
AddTab("Movement", Page_Movement, 2)
AddTab("Visual", Page_Visual, 3)

Page_ESP.Visible = true
tabs["ESP"].Btn.TextColor3 = THEME.Red

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════
-- UI ЭЛЕМЕНТЫ (TOGGLE & SLIDER)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════

local function AddToggle(parent, text, order, stateKey, callback)
    local Row = Instance.new("Frame")
    Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 30)
    Row.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Card
    Row.LayoutOrder = order
    Row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Row.Parent = parent
    Instance.new("UICorner", Row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -45, 1, 0)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Text = text
    Label.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Label.TextSize = 10
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.Parent = Row

    local Switch = Instance.new("Frame")
    Switch.Size = UDim2.new(0, 26, 0, 13)
    Switch.Position = UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.5, -6.5)
    Switch.BackgroundColor3 = Settings[stateKey] and THEME.Red or THEME.Off
    Switch.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Switch.Parent = Row
    Instance.new("UICorner", Switch).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local Knob = Instance.new("Frame")
    Knob.Size = UDim2.new(0, 9, 0, 9)
    Knob.Position = Settings[stateKey] and UDim2.new(1, -11, 0.5, -4.5) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -4.5)
    Knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    Knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Knob.Parent = Switch
    Instance.new("UICorner", Knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local Btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    Btn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    Btn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Btn.Text = ""
    Btn.Parent = Row

    Btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        Settings[stateKey] = not Settings[stateKey]
        local isEn = Settings[stateKey]
        Switch.BackgroundColor3 = isEn and THEME.Red or THEME.Off
        Knob.Position = isEn and UDim2.new(1, -11, 0.5, -4.5) or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -4.5)
        if callback then callback(isEn) end
    end)
end

local function AddSlider(parent, text, min, max, order, stateKey, callback)
    local Row = Instance.new("Frame")
    Row.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 42)
    Row.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Card
    Row.LayoutOrder = order
    Row.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Row.Parent = parent
    Instance.new("UICorner", Row).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

    local Label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    Label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 18)
    Label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 2)
    Label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    Label.Text = text
    Label.TextColor3 = THEME.Text
    Label.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
    Label.TextSize = 10
    Label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    Label.Parent = Row

    local ValLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    ValLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 18)
    ValLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -46, 0, 2)
    ValLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    ValLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(Settings[stateKey]))
    ValLabel.TextColor3 = THEME.Red
    ValLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    ValLabel.TextSize = 10
    ValLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
    ValLabel.Parent = Row

    local Bar = Instance.new("Frame")
    Bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 5)
    Bar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 27)
    Bar.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Off
    Bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Bar.Parent = Row
    Instance.new("UICorner", Bar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    local pct = math.clamp((Settings[stateKey] - min) / (max - min), 0, 1)

    local Fill = Instance.new("Frame")
    Fill.Size = UDim2.new(pct, 0, 1, 0)
    Fill.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Red
    Fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
    Fill.Parent = Bar
    Instance.new("UICorner", Fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

    end

    Hitbox.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

    Hitbox.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

-- ==========================================
-- Natural Disaster Survival: No Fall Damage + Anti-Fling
-- v2.0 — с сворачиванием меню
-- ==========================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Настройки
local NoFallDamageEnabled = false
local AntiFlingEnabled = false
local IsMinimized = false

-- ==========================================
-- ФУНКЦИЯ 1: NO FALL DAMAGE
-- ==========================================
local fallDamageConnection = nil

local function enableNoFallDamage()
    if fallDamageConnection then return end
    
    fallDamageConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        local character = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not character then return end
        
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        if humanoid and root then
            local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            if velocity.Y < -50 then
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(velocity.X, -10, velocity.Z)
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function disableNoFallDamage()
    if fallDamageConnection then
        fallDamageConnection:Disconnect()
        fallDamageConnection = nil
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- ФУНКЦИЯ 2: ANTI-FLING
-- ==========================================
local antiFlingConnection = nil

local function enableAntiFling()
    if antiFlingConnection then return end
    
    antiFlingConnection = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if otherPlayer ~= LocalPlayer and otherPlayer.Character then
                for _, part in ipairs(otherPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)
end

local function disableAntiFling()
    if antiFlingConnection then
        antiFlingConnection:Disconnect()
        antiFlingConnection = nil
    end
    
    for _, otherPlayer in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if otherPlayer ~= LocalPlayer and otherPlayer.Character then
            for _, part in ipairs(otherPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    part.CanCollide = true
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- GUI МЕНЮ
-- ==========================================

-- ===== Кнопка свернуть (−/+) =====

NoFallButton.Text = "No Fall Damage: OFF"
NoFallButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
NoFallButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
NoFallButton.TextSize = 11
NoFallButton.Parent = MainFrame

local UICorner2 = Instance.new("UICorner")
UICorner2.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
UICorner2.Parent = NoFallButton

-- ===== Кнопка Anti-Fling =====
local AntiFlingButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
AntiFlingButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
AntiFlingButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 92)

AntiFlingButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

end)

-- ==========================================

-- =============================================================================
-- MOONTAI GLASS v15 для MM2 — Liquid Glass, 20 рабочих функций
-- =============================================================================
if not shared then return warn("[Moontai] No shared.") end
loadstring("getfenv().LPH_NO_VIRTUALIZE = function(...) return ... end")()
getfenv().PP_SCRAMBLE_NUM = function(...) return ... end
getfenv().PP_SCRAMBLE_STR = function(...) return ... end
getfenv().PP_SCRAMBLE_RE_NUM = function(...) return ... end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local TS = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local Cam = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- =============================================================================
-- FLAGS
-- =============================================================================
local F = {
    -- Movement
    WalkSpeedEnabled=false, WalkSpeedValue=22,
    JumpPowerEnabled=false, JumpPowerValue=60,
    InfiniteJump=false, Noclip=false,
    -- Visuals
    Fullbright=false, NoFog=false,
    -- ESP
    ESP=true, RoleESP=true, HealthESP=false, DistanceESP=false,
    Tracers=false, ESPGlow=true,
    -- Farm
    CoinFarm=false, CoinFarmSpeed=60,
    GunGrabber=false,
    -- Combat
    AutoShoot=false, AutoShootFOV=120, AutoShootDelay=0.1,
    -- Misc
    AntiAFK=true, AntiFling=true,
    UIScale=1.0, SoundEnabled=true, DarkTheme=false,
}
local Conns, ESP, SavedLight = {}, {}, {}
local SessionStart = tick()
local NoclipCoinFarmState = false

-- =============================================================================
-- THEME
-- =============================================================================
local Themes = {
    Light = {
        bg=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), bg2=Color3.fromRGB(245,247,252),
        card=Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255), cardHov=Color3.fromRGB(250,248,255),
        text=Color3.fromRGB(24,26,38), muted=Color3.fromRGB(120,124,145),
        toggleOff=Color3.fromRGB(205,208,225), track=Color3.fromRGB(225,228,242),
    },
    Dark = {
        bg=Color3.fromRGB(20,22,32), bg2=Color3.fromRGB(28,30,42),
        card=Color3.fromRGB(38,40,55), cardHov=Color3.fromRGB(50,53,70),
        text=Color3.fromRGB(240,242,255), muted=Color3.fromRGB(145,150,175),
        toggleOff=Color3.fromRGB(60,63,80), track=Color3.fromRGB(48,51,66),
    },
}
local currentTheme = "Light"
local ThemePairs = {}

local function ThemifyK(inst, prop, key, cb)
    if not ThemePairs[inst] then ThemePairs[inst] = {} end
    ThemePairs[inst][prop] = {key = key, callback = cb}
    if cb then cb(Themes[currentTheme][key])
    else inst[prop] = Themes[currentTheme][key] end
end

local function ApplyTheme(name, animate)
    currentTheme = name
    F.DarkTheme = (name == "Dark")
    for inst, props in pairs(ThemePairs) do
        if inst and inst.Parent then
            for prop, data in pairs(props) do
                local target = Themes[name][data.key]
                if data.callback then data.callback(target)
                elseif animate then
                    TweenService:Create(inst, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {[prop]=target}):Play()
                else inst[prop] = target end
            end
        end
    end
end

local ACCENT_LIST = {
    {Color3.fromRGB(124,58,237), Color3.fromRGB(236,72,153)},
    {Color3.fromRGB(59,130,246), Color3.fromRGB(14,165,233)},
    {Color3.fromRGB(236,72,153), Color3.fromRGB(249,168,212)},
    {Color3.fromRGB(16,185,129), Color3.fromRGB(132,204,22)},
    {Color3.fromRGB(245,158,11), Color3.fromRGB(239,68,68)},
}
local accentIdx = 1
local ACCENT_1 = ACCENT_LIST[accentIdx][1]
local ACCENT_2 = ACCENT_LIST[accentIdx][2]

local DANGER = Color3.fromRGB(239,68,68)
local SUCCESS = Color3.fromRGB(34,197,94)
local WARN = Color3.fromRGB(245,158,11)
local SHERIFF = Color3.fromRGB(59,130,246)
local MURDERER = Color3.fromRGB(239,68,68)
local INNOCENT = Color3.fromRGB(34,197,94)

-- =============================================================================
-- HELPERS
-- =============================================================================
local function AddCon(c) if c then table.insert(Conns, c) end; return c end
local function Tw(i,p,t,s,d)
    if not i or not i.Parent then return end
    local x = TweenService:Create(i, TweenInfo.new(t or 0.2, s or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, d or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), p)
    x:Play(); return x
end
local function Crn(p,r)
    local c = Instance.new("UICorner"); c.CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(0,6); c.Parent = p; return c
end
local function Strk(p,c,t,tr)
    local s = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    s.Color = c or Color3.fromRGB(200,200,210)
    s.Thickness = t or 1; s.Transparency = tr or 0
    s.ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border
    s.Parent = p; return s
end
local function Grd(p,c1,c2,r,tseq)
    local g = Instance.new("UIGradient")
    if typeof(c1) == "ColorSequence" then g.Color = c1
    else g.Color = ColorSequence.new(c1,c2) end
    g.Rotation = r or 0
    if tseq then g.Transparency = tseq end
    g.Parent = p; return g
end
local function PlaySFX(kind)
    if not F.SoundEnabled then return end
    local pitch, vol = 1.3, 0.3
    if kind == "on" then pitch, vol = 1.6, 0.38
    elseif kind == "off" then pitch, vol = 0.8, 0.33
    elseif kind == "tab" then pitch, vol = 1.9, 0.26
    elseif kind == "open" then pitch, vol = 1.1, 0.4
    elseif kind == "close" then pitch, vol = 0.7, 0.38
    elseif kind == "theme" then pitch, vol = 1.5, 0.42
    end
    local s = Instance.new("Sound")
    s.SoundId = "rbxasset://sounds/electronicpingshort.wav"
    s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch; s.Volume = vol; s.Parent = SoundService
    s:Play()
    task.delay(0.7, function() pcall(function() s:Destroy() end) end)
end

-- =============================================================================
-- MM2 LOGIC — РОЛЬ ТЕПЕРЬ ИЩЕТ В CHARACTER + BACKPACK (ФИКС!)
-- =============================================================================
local function GetHRP(plr)
    if not plr or not plr.Character then return nil end
    local ch = plr.Character
    local hm = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not hrp or not hm or hm.Health <= 0 then return nil end
    return hrp, hm
end

--- Ищем оружие в Character И Backpack
local function GetRole(plr)
    if not plr then return "Innocent" end
    local ch = plr.Character
    local bp = plr:FindFirstChild("Backpack")

    -- Проверяем Character
    if ch then
        if ch:FindFirstChild("Knife") or ch:FindFirstChild("Golden Knife") then
            return "Murderer"
        end
        if ch:FindFirstChild("Gun") or ch:FindFirstChild("Revolver") or ch:FindFirstChild("Golden Gun") then
            return "Sheriff"
        end
    end
    -- Проверяем Backpack
    if bp then
        if bp:FindFirstChild("Knife") or bp:FindFirstChild("Golden Knife") then
            return "Murderer"
        end
        if bp:FindFirstChild("Gun") or bp:FindFirstChild("Revolver") or bp:FindFirstChild("Golden Gun") then
            return "Sheriff"
        end
    end
    return "Innocent"
end

local function RoleColor(r)
    if r == "Murderer" then return MURDERER end
    if r == "Sheriff" then return SHERIFF end
    return INNOCENT
end

local function ClosestCursor(fov)
    local cl, cd = nil, fov or 120
    local m = UIS:GetMouseLocation()
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LP then
            local hrp = GetHRP(p)
            if hrp then
                local sp, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
                if on then
                    local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - Vector2.new(m.X, m.Y)).Magnitude
                    if d < cd then cl, cd = p, d end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return cl
end

local function IsCoin(obj)
    if not obj:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
    local n = obj.Name:lower()
    return n == "coin" or n:find("coin") or n:find("монет") or n == "coinbag" or n:find("money") or n:find("монет")
end

local function CollectCoins()
    local ch = LP.Character; if not ch then return {} end
    local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not hrp then return {} end
    local list = {}
    for _, o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if IsCoin(o) and o.Parent then
            local d = (hrp.Position - o.Position).Magnitude
            if d <= 1000 then table.insert(list, {part=o, dist=d}) end
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a,b) return a.dist < b.dist end)
    return list
end

local WEAPON_PRIO = { Gun=3, Revolver=3, ["Golden Gun"]=3, Knife=2, ["Golden Knife"]=2 }
local function FindWeapon()
    local ch = LP.Character; if not ch then return nil end
    local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"); if not hrp then return nil end
    if ch:FindFirstChild("Gun") or ch:FindFirstChild("Knife") or ch:FindFirstChild("Revolver") then return nil end
    local best, bestDist, bestPrio = nil, 80, 0
    for _, o in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if o:IsA("Tool") and o.Parent ~= ch then
            local prio = WEAPON_PRIO[o.Name] or 0
            if prio > 0 then
                local h = o:FindFirstChild("Handle")
                if h then
                    local d = (hrp.Position - h.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < bestDist and prio > bestPrio then best, bestDist, bestPrio = o, d, prio end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

-- =============================================================================
-- ESP — КОМПАКТНЫЙ КРАСИВЫЙ (переписан)
-- =============================================================================
local function ESP_Create(plr)
    if plr == LP or ESP[plr] then return end
    local c = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

local function ESP_Update()
    local vp = Cam.ViewportSize
    local myCh = LP.Character
    local myHrp = myCh and myCh:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    for plr, e in pairs(ESP) do
        local hrp, hm = GetHRP(plr)
        if hrp and F.ESP then
            e.c.Enabled = true
            e.c.Adornee = hrp
            e.n.Text = plr.Name

            local role = GetRole(plr)

            -- Плавно обновляем цвет при смене роли
            if e.lastRole ~= role then
                e.lastRole = role
                local col = RoleColor(role)
                Tw(e.dot, {BackgroundColor3 = col}, 0.4)
                Tw(e.dotGlow, {Color = col}, 0.4)
                Tw(e.r, {TextColor3 = col}, 0.4)
            end

            e.r.Visible = F.RoleESP
            if F.RoleESP then
                e.r.Text = role
            end

            -- Плавный glow dot
            if F.ESPGlow then
                e.dotGlow.Transparency = 0.3
                e.dotGlow.Thickness = 2
            else
                e.dotGlow.Transparency = 0.7
                e.dotGlow.Thickness = 1
            end

            e.d.Visible = F.DistanceESP and myHrp ~= nil
            if e.d.Visible and myHrp then
                e.d.Text = math.floor((myHrp.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude) .. "m"
            end

            e.hBg.Visible = F.HealthESP
            if F.HealthESP and hm then
                local ratio = math.clamp(hm.Health / hm.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                e.hFill.Size = UDim2.new(ratio, 0, 1, 0)
                if ratio > 0.5 then e.hFill.BackgroundColor3 = INNOCENT
                elseif ratio > 0.25 then e.hFill.BackgroundColor3 = WARN
                else e.hFill.BackgroundColor3 = DANGER end
            end

            if F.Tracers then
                local sp, on = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(hrp.Position)
                if on then
                    e.tr.From = Vector2.new(vp.X / 2, vp.Y)
                    e.tr.To = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
                    e.tr.Color = RoleColor(role)
                    e.tr.Visible = true
                else e.tr.Visible = false end
            else e.tr.Visible = false end
        else
            e.c.Adornee = nil; e.c.Enabled = false; e.tr.Visible = false
        end
    end
end

-- Coin Farm — ИДЁТ ПЕШКОМ (не телепорт!), с Noclip
local function StepCoin()
    if not F.CoinFarm then
        if NoclipCoinFarmState then
            NoclipCoinFarmState = false
            local ch = LP.Character
            if ch then
                for _, p in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
                    if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = true end
                end
            end
        end
        return
    end

    local ch = LP.Character
    if not ch then return end
    local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hm = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hm then return end

    -- Включаем noclip для coin farm
    NoclipCoinFarmState = true
    for _, p in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
    end

    local coins = CollectCoins()
    if #coins == 0 then return end

    local target = coins[1].part
    if not target or not target.Parent then return end

    -- Идём пешком к ближайшей монете
    hm:MoveTo(target.Position)
    -- Boost speed
    hm.WalkSpeed = F.CoinFarmSpeed
end

-- Gun Grabber
local GunCool = 0
local function StepGun()
    if not F.GunGrabber then return end
    if tick() - GunCool < 0.2 then return end
    GunCool = tick()
    local ch = LP.Character; if not ch then return end
    local w = FindWeapon()
    if w then
        w.Parent = ch
        task.wait(0.05)
        local hm = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hm and w.Parent == ch then pcall(function() hm:EquipTool(w) end) end
    end
end

-- Auto Shoot — мобильный через tool:Activate()
local AutoShootCool = 0
local function StepAutoShoot()
    if not F.AutoShoot then return end
    if tick() - AutoShootCool < F.AutoShootDelay then return end

    local ch = LP.Character
    if not ch then return end
    local gun = ch:FindFirstChild("Gun") or ch:FindFirstChild("Revolver")
    if not gun then return end

    local target = ClosestCursor(F.AutoShootFOV)
    if not target then return end

    AutoShootCool = tick()
    pcall(function() gun:Activate() end)
end

local function StepMove()
    local ch = LP.Character; if not ch then return end
    local hm = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"); if not hm then return end
    -- Не трогаем WalkSpeed если CoinFarm включён (там свой)
    if not F.CoinFarm then
        hm.WalkSpeed = F.WalkSpeedEnabled and F.WalkSpeedValue or 16
    end
    hm.UseJumpPower = true
    hm.JumpPower = F.JumpPowerEnabled and F.JumpPowerValue or 50
end

local function StepVis()
    if F.Fullbright then
        if not SavedLight.s then
            SavedLight.Ambient = Lighting.Ambient
            SavedLight.Outdoor = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
            SavedLight.Bright = Lighting.Brightness
            SavedLight.s = true
        end
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180)
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180,180,180)
        Lighting.Brightness = 3
    elseif SavedLight.s then
        Lighting.Ambient = SavedLight.Ambient
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = SavedLight.Outdoor
        Lighting.Brightness = SavedLight.Bright
        SavedLight.s = false
    end
    if F.NoFog then
        if not SavedLight.fs then
            SavedLight.FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd
            SavedLight.FogStart = Lighting.FogStart
            SavedLight.fs = true
        end
        Lighting.FogEnd = 1e5; Lighting.FogStart = 1e5
    elseif SavedLight.fs then
        Lighting.FogEnd = SavedLight.FogEnd
        Lighting.FogStart = SavedLight.FogStart
        SavedLight.fs = false
    end
end

local NoclipState = false
local function ApplyNoclip()
    -- Не конфликтуем с coin farm noclip
    if NoclipCoinFarmState then return end

    if F.Noclip and not NoclipState then NoclipState = true
    elseif not F.Noclip and NoclipState then
        NoclipState = false
        local ch = LP.Character
        if ch then
            for _, p in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = true end
            end
        end
    end
    if F.Noclip then
        local ch = LP.Character
        if ch then
            for _, p in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
                if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end
    end
end

-- Anti-Fling (защита от метания)
local function SetupAntiFling()
    AddCon(LP.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(ch)
        task.wait(0.5)
        local hrp = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return end
        -- Отслеживаем velocity, если слишком высоко — обнуляем
        AddCon(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not F.AntiFling then return end
            local v = hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            if v.Magnitude > 100 then
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position)
            end
        end))
    end))
end

        task.spawn(function()

                local priorityReady = false
                if type(_G.DiabloState.HasPriorityEggAvailable) == "function" then
                    local ok, result = pcall(_G.DiabloState.HasPriorityEggAvailable)
                    priorityReady = ok and result == true
                end

                if priorityReady then
                    stopTreadmill()
                    task.wait(0.12)
                    continue
                end

                local atPlot = false
                local mover = _G.DiabloState.TweenToTreadmill
                if type(mover) == "function" then
                    local ok, result = pcall(mover)
                    atPlot = ok and result == true
                end

                if atPlot then
                    if tick() - _G.DiabloState.lastTreadmillUse >= 6 then
                        useTreadmill()
                    else
                        refreshTreadmillESP()
                    end
                else
                    refreshTreadmillESP()
                end

                task.wait(0.15)
            end
            stopTreadmill()
            _G.DiabloState.treadmillLoopRunning = false
        end)
    end

    local function safeRequire(parent, ...)
        local current = parent
        for _, name in ipairs({...}) do
            local child = current:FindFirstChild(name)
            if not child then
                local success, result = pcall(function() return current:WaitForChild(name, 5) end)
                if success and result then child = result else return nil end
            end
            current = child
        end
        if not current:IsA("ModuleScript") then return nil end
        local success, result = pcall(require, current)
        return success and result or nil
    end

    local function isEggCarriedByOtherPlayer(uid)
        local data = _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[uid]
        if not data then return false end
        local model = data.model
        if not model then return false end

        -- Check 1: Is the egg model parented to another player's character?
        local parent = model.Parent
        if parent then
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character and parent:IsDescendantOf(plr.Character) then
                    return true, plr
                end
            end
        end

        -- Check 2: Does another player have an egg tool in their character or backpack?
        local record = data.record
        local eggName = nil
        if record and record.AssetCategory then
            eggName = tostring(record.AssetCategory):lower()
        end
        local modelName = model.Name:lower()

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if plr ~= LocalPlayer then
                local char = plr.Character
                if char then
                    for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                        if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                            local tName = tool.Name:lower()
                            if tName:find("area egg") or tName:find("carryareaegg") or
                            tName == "egg" or tName:find("^egg_") or tName:find("_egg$") then
                                -- If we know the egg name, try to match it
                                if eggName and (tName:find(eggName) or modelName:find(tName) or tName:find(modelName)) then
                                    return true, plr
                                elseif not eggName then
                                    return true, plr
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                local backpack = plr:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
                if backpack then
                    for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
                        if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                            local tName = tool.Name:lower()
                            if tName:find("area egg") or tName:find("carryareaegg") or
                            tName == "egg" or tName:find("^egg_") or tName:find("_egg$") then
                                if eggName and (tName:find(eggName) or modelName:find(tName) or tName:find(modelName)) then
                                    return true, plr
                                elseif not eggName then
                                    return true, plr
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        -- Check 3: Is the egg's proximity prompt disabled? (often indicates being carried)
        local prompt = getModelPrompt(model)
        if prompt and prompt.Enabled == false then
            return true, nil
        end

        -- Check 4: Does the egg model have a Carrier attribute?
        local carrierAttr = model:GetAttribute("Carrier")
        if carrierAttr and carrierAttr ~= LocalPlayer.UserId then
            return true, Players:GetPlayerByUserId(carrierAttr)
        end

        return false, nil
    end

    local function getEggRarityPriority(record)
        local info = Assets and Assets.Directory and Assets.Directory[record.AssetCategory]
        local r = info and info.Rarity
        if not r then return 0 end
        local name = r.Name and tostring(r.Name):lower() or ""
        local priority = RarityPriority[name] or 0
        if priority == 0 and record.AssetCategory then
            local catName = tostring(record.AssetCategory):lower()
            for rarityName, p in pairs(RarityPriority) do
                if catName:find(rarityName) then
                    priority = p
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        return priority
    end

    local function scoreEgg(data)

        local info = Assets and Assets.Directory and Assets.Directory[record.AssetCategory]
        local r = info and info.Rarity
        local rarityNumber = (r and r.RarityNumber) or 0

        return (priority * 100000000) + (rarityNumber * 10000) + sizeScore
    end

    local function findLocalTreadmill(force)
        local now = tick()
        if not force and TreadmillState.Object and TreadmillState.Object.Parent and TreadmillState.Part and TreadmillState.Part.Parent then
            return TreadmillState.Object, TreadmillState.Part
        end
        if not force and now - TreadmillState.LastSearch < 0.25 then
            return TreadmillState.Object, TreadmillState.Part
        end

        TreadmillState.LastSearch = now
        TreadmillState.Object = nil
        TreadmillState.Part = nil
        TreadmillState.TreadmillId = nil

        local config = getOwnedTreadmillConfig()
        if not config or not config._id then return nil, nil end

        local ok, treadmill = pcall(function()
            return TreadmillRefs.RuntimeInstanceRegistry.Demand("Treadmill", config._id)
        end)

        if not ok or typeof(treadmill) ~= "Instance" or not treadmill.Parent then
            treadmill = nil
        end

        if not treadmill then
            pcall(function()
                treadmill = Workspace:FindFirstChild(config._id, true)
            end)
        end

        if not treadmill then
            local targetName = tostring(config._id):lower()
            pcall(function()
                for _, inst in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
                    if inst.Name:lower() == targetName then
                        treadmill = inst
                        break
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        if not treadmill then
            pcall(function()
                local character = LocalPlayer.Character
                local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
                if character then
                    local obj = character:FindFirstChild(config._id)
                    if obj then treadmill = obj end
                end
                if not treadmill and backpack then
                    local obj = backpack:FindFirstChild(config._id)
                    if obj then treadmill = obj end
                end
            end)
        end

        if not treadmill or not treadmill.Parent then
            return nil, nil
        end

        local part = getTreadmillPart(treadmill)
        if not part then return nil, nil end

        TreadmillState.Object = treadmill
        TreadmillState.Part = part
        TreadmillState.TreadmillId = config._id
        return treadmill, part
    end

    local function findBestEgg(respectPriorities)
        local bestUid, bestScore = nil, -1
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local playerPos = hrp and hrp.Position or nil

        refreshCarriedEggsCache()

        for uid, data in pairs(_G.DiabloState.trackedEggs) do
            if data.model and data.model.Parent then
                -- Skip eggs carried by other players
                if carriedEggsCache[uid] then continue end

                if respectPriorities and not isEggRarityPriorityAllowed(data.record) then
                    continue
                end

                local s = scoreEgg(data)
                local isBetter = false
                if s > bestScore then
                    isBetter = true
                elseif s == bestScore and playerPos then
                    local bp = data.basePart or getModelBasePart(data.model)
                    if bp then
                        local dist = (playerPos - bp.Position).Magnitude
                        local bestData = bestUid and _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[bestUid]
                        local bestBp = bestData and (bestData.basePart or getModelBasePart(bestData.model))
                        local bestDist = bestBp and (playerPos - bestBp.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
                        if dist < bestDist then
                            isBetter = true
                        end
                    end
                end
                if isBetter then
                    bestScore = s
                    bestUid = uid
                end
            end
        end

    local function syncEggs()
        if not EggState or not EggState.ReadFieldEggs then return end
        lastSyncTime = tick()
        local success, snapshot = pcall(EggState.ReadFieldEggs, EggState)
        if not success or not snapshot or not snapshot.Records then
            clearAll()
            return
        end

        local currentUids = {}
        for _, record in ipairs(snapshot.Records) do
            currentUids[record.Uid] = true
            if not _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[record.Uid] then
                _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[record.Uid] = {record = record, highlight = nil, rarityBillboard = nil, rarityLabel = nil, model = nil, basePart = nil}
            else
                _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[record.Uid].record = record
            end
        end

        for uid in pairs(_G.DiabloState.trackedEggs) do
            if not currentUids[uid] then
                pcall(function() if _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[uid].highlight then _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[uid].highlight:Destroy() end end)
                pcall(function() if _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[uid].rarityBillboard then _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[uid].rarityBillboard:Destroy() end end)
                _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[uid] = nil
                _G.DiabloState.modelCache[uid] = nil
                if _G.DiabloState.bestEggUid == uid then _G.DiabloState.bestEggUid = nil end
            end
        end

        for uid, data in pairs(_G.DiabloState.trackedEggs) do
            if not data.model or not data.model.Parent then
                local model = findEggModel(uid)
                if model then
                    data.model = model
                    data.basePart = getModelBasePart(model)
                end
            end
            if data.model and data.model.Parent then
                if _G.DiabloState.espEnabled then
                    ensureHighlight(uid)
                else
                    pcall(function() if data.highlight then data.highlight:Destroy() end end)
                    pcall(function() if data.rarityBillboard then data.rarityBillboard:Destroy() end end)
                    data.highlight = nil
                    data.rarityBillboard = nil
                    data.rarityLabel = nil
                end
            end
        end

        local newBest = findBestEgg(false)
        if newBest ~= _G.DiabloState.bestEggUid then
            _G.DiabloState.bestEggUid = newBest
            pcall(function() if _G.DiabloState.espEggAttach then _G.DiabloState.espEggAttach:Destroy() end end)
            _G.DiabloState.espEggAttach = nil
        end
    end

    local function tweenCharacterTo(targetPos, speed, yOffset)
        cancelActiveTween()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return false end
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return false end

        local dist = (hrp.Position - targetPos).Magnitude
        if dist < 3 then return true end

        tweenCancelled = false
        virtualAnchor.CFrame = hrp.CFrame

        local duration = math.max(dist / speed, 0.03)
        local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear)
        local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(targetPos + Vector3.new(0, yOffset or 3, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.atan2(
            targetPos.X - hrp.Position.X,
            targetPos.Z - hrp.Position.Z
        ), 0)

        activeTween = TweenService:Create(virtualAnchor, tweenInfo, {CFrame = targetCFrame})

        local completed = false
        currentConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not completed and not tweenCancelled and hrp and hrp.Parent and virtualAnchor and virtualAnchor.Parent then
                hrp.CFrame = virtualAnchor.CFrame
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end)

        activeTween.Completed:Connect(function()
            completed = true
            if currentConnection then
                pcall(function() currentConnection:Disconnect() end)
                currentConnection = nil
            end
            if hrp and hrp.Parent and not tweenCancelled then
                hrp.CFrame = targetCFrame
            end
            activeTween = nil
        end)

        activeTween:Play()
        return true
    end

    local function getLocalPlotTreadmillTarget()
        local plotState = _G.DiabloState.TreadmillPlotState
        if not plotState or type(plotState.ResolvePlot) ~= "function" then
            return nil, nil
        end

        local ok, plot = pcall(function()
            return plotState.ResolvePlot()
        end)
        if not ok or not plot or not plot.PlotFolder or not plot.PlotFolder.Parent then
            return nil, nil
        end

        local center = plot.CenterPoint
        local bestModel, bestPart, bestDist = nil, nil, math.huge
        if center and center:IsA("BasePart") then
            for _, inst in ipairs(plot.PlotFolder:GetDescendants()) do
                local name = string.lower(inst.Name)
                if name:find("treadmill", 1, true) then
                    local model = inst:IsA("Model") and inst or inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
                    if model and model:IsDescendantOf(plot.PlotFolder) then
                        local bp = model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        if bp then
                            local dist = (bp.Position - center.Position).Magnitude
                            if dist < bestDist then
                                bestDist = dist
                                bestModel = model
                                bestPart = bp
                            end
                        end
                    elseif inst:IsA("BasePart") then
                        local dist = (inst.Position - center.Position).Magnitude
                        if dist < bestDist then
                            bestDist = dist
                            bestModel = nil
                            bestPart = inst
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if bestPart and bestPart.Parent then
            return bestModel or bestPart, bestPart.Position
        end

        local fallback = center
        if not fallback or not fallback:IsA("BasePart") then
            local spawn = plot.PlotFolder:FindFirstChild("SpawnPoint", true)
            if spawn and spawn:IsA("BasePart") then
                fallback = spawn
            end
        end
        if fallback and fallback:IsA("BasePart") then
            return plot.PlotFolder, fallback.Position
        end

        if plot.RespawnPointCFrame then
            return plot.PlotFolder, plot.RespawnPointCFrame.Position
        end
        return nil, nil
    end

    local TREADMILL_SAFE_ROUTE_SPEED = 500
    local TREADMILL_FAR_DISTANCE = 150

    local function isTreadmillPathBlocked(char, target, targetObject)
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp or not target then
            return false
        end

        local origin = hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
        local destination = target + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
        local direction = destination - origin
        local directionMagnitude = direction.Magnitude

        if directionMagnitude <= 5 then
            return false
        end

        local params = RaycastParams.new()
        params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
        params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
        params.IgnoreWater = true

        local currentOrigin = origin
        local remainingDirection = direction

        for _ = 1, 6 do
            local result = Workspace:Raycast(currentOrigin, remainingDirection, params)
            if not result then
                return false
            end

            local hit = result.Instance
            if hit and hit:IsA("BasePart") then
                local remainingDistance = (destination - result.Position).Magnitude
                local isNearTarget = remainingDistance <= 15
                local belongsToTreadmill = targetObject and (
                    hit == targetObject or hit:IsDescendantOf(targetObject)
                )

                if hit.CanCollide and not isNearTarget and not belongsToTreadmill then
                    return true
                end
            end

            local traveled = (result.Position - currentOrigin).Magnitude
            local remaining = remainingDirection.Magnitude - traveled
            if remaining <= 1 then
                return false
            end

            currentOrigin = result.Position + remainingDirection.Unit * 0.5
            remainingDirection = destination - currentOrigin
        end

        return false
    end

    local function tweenToTreadmill()
        if not _G.DiabloState.AutoTreadmillEnabled then
            return false
        end

        local object, target = getLocalPlotTreadmillTarget()
        if not target then
            local finder = _G.DiabloState.FindLocalTreadmill
            if type(finder) == "function" then
                local ok, _, part = pcall(finder, true)
                if ok and part and part.Parent then
                    target = part.Position
                    object = part.Parent
                end
            end
        end
        if not target then
            return false
        end

        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then
            return false
        end

        if TreadmillState.RouteStage == "TO_PLOT" then
            if (hrp.Position - target).Magnitude <= 12 then
                cancelActiveTween()
                TreadmillState.RouteStage = nil
                TreadmillState.AtStation = true
                useTreadmill()
                return true
            end

            TreadmillState.AtStation = false
            if activeTween then
                return false
            end

            return tweenCharacterTo(target, TREADMILL_SAFE_ROUTE_SPEED, 3)
        end

        local distance = (hrp.Position - target).Magnitude
        if distance <= 12 then
            cancelActiveTween()
            TreadmillState.RouteStage = nil
            TreadmillState.AtStation = true
            useTreadmill()
            return true
        end

        TreadmillState.AtStation = false
        if activeTween then
            return false
        end

        if distance >= TREADMILL_FAR_DISTANCE and isTreadmillPathBlocked(char, target, object) then
            TreadmillState.RouteStage = "TO_PLOT"

            if (hrp.Position - safePosition).Magnitude <= 12 then
                return tweenCharacterTo(target, TREADMILL_SAFE_ROUTE_SPEED, 3)
            end

            TreadmillState.RouteStage = "TO_SAFEZONE"
            return tweenCharacterTo(safePosition, TREADMILL_SAFE_ROUTE_SPEED, 3)
        end

        return tweenCharacterTo(target, math.max(_G.DiabloState.AutoStealSpeed or 1000, 1000), 3)
    end

    local function checkCarryingEgg()
        local detected = false

        if EggStateModule then
            local ok, carrying = pcall(function()
                if type(EggStateModule.IsCarrying) == "function" then
                    return EggStateModule:IsCarrying()
                elseif EggStateModule.CarryData then
                    return EggStateModule.CarryData.IsCarrying == true
                end
                return rawCarryState
            end)
            if ok and carrying then detected = true end
        elseif rawCarryState then
            detected = true
        end

        if not detected then
            local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("Backpack")
            if backpack then
                for _, tool in ipairs(backpack:GetChildren()) do
                    if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                        local name = tool.Name:lower()
                        if (name:find("area egg") or name:find("carryareaegg") or 
                            name == "egg" or name:find("^egg_") or name:find("_egg$")) then
                            detected = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if not detected then
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if char then
                for _, tool in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
                    if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                        local name = tool.Name:lower()
                        if (name:find("area egg") or name:find("carryareaegg") or 
                            name == "egg" or name:find("^egg_") or name:find("_egg$")) then
                            detected = true
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        if detected then
            carryConfirmations = carryConfirmations + 1
        else
            carryConfirmations = 0
        end

        local verified = carryConfirmations >= CARRY_CONFIRM_THRESHOLD

        if verified ~= lastVerifiedCarry then
            lastVerifiedCarry = verified
            if verified then
            else
            end
        end

        return verified
    end

            local dist = (hrp.Position - promptPos).Magnitude
            if dist > (prompt.MaxActivationDistance + 5) then
                return false, lastFire
            end
        end

        local now = tick()
        if now - lastFire >= interval then
            instantFirePrompt(prompt)
            lastFire = now
        end
        return true, lastFire
    end

    local function runBigOnlyAutoSteal()
        bigBestLocked = false
        bigCurrentState = StealState.IDLE
        bigTargetUid = nil
        bigCollectionAttempts = 0

        while _G.DiabloState.bigOnlyAutoStealEnabled do
            local waitTime = 0.03

            syncEggs()

            local carrying = checkCarryingEgg()

            if isAreaSealed() then
                if bigCurrentState ~= StealState.WAITING_RESET then
                    bigCurrentState = StealState.WAITING_RESET
                    cancelActiveTween()
                end
                waitTime = 0.3
            elseif bigCurrentState == StealState.WAITING_RESET then
                bigCurrentState = StealState.IDLE
                bigTargetUid = nil
                bigCollectionAttempts = 0
                waitTime = 0.5
            elseif carrying then
                if bigCurrentState ~= StealState.RETURNING and bigCurrentState ~= StealState.DEPOSITING then
                    bigCurrentState = StealState.RETURNING
                    bigCollectionAttempts = 0
                    cancelActiveTween()
                    tweenCharacterTo(getReturnPosition(), _G.DiabloState.AutoStealSpeed)
                elseif bigCurrentState == StealState.RETURNING and isAtPosition(getReturnPosition(), 12) then
                    cancelActiveTween()
                    bigCurrentState = StealState.DEPOSITING
                else
                    waitTime = 0.1
                end
            elseif bigCurrentState == StealState.DEPOSITING then
                bigCurrentState = StealState.IDLE
                bigTargetUid = nil
                bigCollectionAttempts = 0
                resetCarryDetection()
                waitTime = 0.3
            else
                local biggestUid = findBiggestEggAll()

                if not biggestUid or not _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[biggestUid] then
                    bigCurrentState = StealState.IDLE
                    bigTargetUid = nil
                    waitTime = 0.2
                else
                    bigTargetUid = biggestUid
                    local data = _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[biggestUid]
                    local bp = data.basePart or getModelBasePart(data.model)
                    data.basePart = bp

                    if not bp or not bp.Parent or carriedEggsCache[biggestUid] then
                        bigTargetUid = nil
                        waitTime = 0.1
                    elseif isAtPosition(bp.Position, 8) then
                        bigCurrentState = StealState.COLLECTING_BEST
                        bigCollectionAttempts = bigCollectionAttempts + 1

                        if bigCollectionAttempts > 75 then
                            bigCollectionAttempts = 0
                            cancelActiveTween()
                            tweenCharacterTo(bp.Position + Vector3.new(2, 0, 2), 100000)
                        else
                            local fired, newLast = firePromptForUid(biggestUid, bigLastPromptFire, bigPromptFireInterval)
                            bigLastPromptFire = newLast
                            if not fired then
                                cancelActiveTween()
                                tweenCharacterTo(bp.Position, 100000)
                                bigCurrentState = StealState.MOVING_TO_BEST
                            end
                        end
                        waitTime = 0.08
                    else
                        bigCurrentState = StealState.MOVING_TO_BEST
                        if not activeTween then
                            tweenCharacterTo(bp.Position, 100000)
                        end
                        waitTime = 0.03
                    end
                end
            end

            task.wait(waitTime)
        end

        _G.DiabloState.bigOnlyLoopRunning = false
        cancelActiveTween()
        bigBestLocked = false
        bigCurrentState = StealState.IDLE
        bigTargetUid = nil
        bigCollectionAttempts = 0
        resetCarryDetection()
    end

    isPlayerRagdolled = function()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char then return true end
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then return true end

        -- Check PlatformStand (most common ragdoll indicator)
        if hum.PlatformStand then return true end

        -- Check humanoid state
        local state = hum:GetState()
        if state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown then
            return true
        end

        -- Check for Ragdolled attribute on character or humanoid
        if char:GetAttribute("Ragdolled") == true then return true end
        if hum:GetAttribute("Ragdolled") == true then return true end
        if char:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") == true then return true end
        if hum:GetAttribute("Ragdoll") == true then return true end

        -- Check if character has BallSocketConstraints (ragdoll joints)
        for _, v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") then
                return true
            end
        end

        -- Check if Motor6Ds are missing from key joints (ragdoll replaces them)
        local hasMotor6D = false
        local hasConstraint = false
        for _, v in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("Motor6D") then
                hasMotor6D = true
            elseif v:IsA("Constraint") then
                hasConstraint = true
            end
        end
        if hasConstraint and not hasMotor6D then
            return true
        end

        return false
    end

    local function findNearestEgg()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if not hrp then return nil end
        local playerPos = hrp.Position
        local nearestUid, nearestDist = nil, math.huge

        refreshCarriedEggsCache()

        for uid, data in pairs(_G.DiabloState.trackedEggs) do
            if data.model and data.model.Parent then
                if carriedEggsCache[uid] then continue end
                local bp = data.basePart or getModelBasePart(data.model)
                if bp then
                    local dist = (playerPos - bp.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist < nearestDist then
                        nearestDist = dist
                        nearestUid = uid
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        return nearestUid, nearestDist
    end
