                currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
                targetEggUid = nil
                targetEggScore = nil
                collectionAttempts = 0
                resetCarryDetection()
                return
            end

            if _G.DiabloState.autoLoopRunning then return end
            _G.DiabloState.autoLoopRunning = true

            local targetUid = nil
            local collectionAttempts = 0
            local maxCollectionAttempts = 20
            local lastPromptFire = 0
            local promptFireInterval = 0.08
            local bestLocked = false
            local autoStealPhase = "NEAREST"
            currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
            targetUid = nil
            collectionAttempts = 0
            cancelActiveTween()

            task.spawn(function()
                while _G.DiabloState.autoStealEnabled do
                    local waitTime = 0.03

                    syncEggs()

                    if _G.DiabloState.AutoTreadmillEnabled and autoStealPhase == "TREADMILL" then
                        refreshTreadmillESP()
                    end

                    local carrying = checkCarryingEgg()
                    local ragdolled = isPlayerRagdolled()

                    if not carrying and autoStealPhase == "NEAREST" and currentStealState == StealState.IDLE then
                        refreshCarriedEggsCache()
                        if not hasPriorityEggAvailable() then
                            if _G.DiabloState.AutoTreadmillEnabled and not _G.DiabloState.bigOnlyAutoStealEnabled then
                                autoStealPhase = "TREADMILL"
                                currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
                                resetTreadmillPath()
                                cancelActiveTween()
                            else
                                cancelActiveTween()
                                waitTime = 0.25
                                task.wait(waitTime)
                                continue
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    if isAreaSealed() then
                        if currentStealState ~= StealState.WAITING_RESET then
                            currentStealState = StealState.WAITING_RESET
                            cancelActiveTween()
                        end
                        waitTime = 0.3
                    elseif currentStealState == StealState.WAITING_RESET then
                        currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
                        waitTime = 0.5
                    elseif autoStealPhase == "TREADMILL" then
                        if not _G.DiabloState.AutoTreadmillEnabled or _G.DiabloState.bigOnlyAutoStealEnabled then
                            resetTreadmillPath()
                            cancelActiveTween()
                            autoStealPhase = "NEAREST"
                            currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
                            waitTime = 0.1
                        elseif hasPriorityEggAvailable() then
                            stopTreadmill()
                            resetTreadmillPath()
                            cancelActiveTween()
                            autoStealPhase = "NEAREST"
                            currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
                            waitTime = 0.01
                        else
                            local atTreadmill = false
                            if type(_G.DiabloState.TweenToTreadmill) == "function" then
                                local ok, result = pcall(_G.DiabloState.TweenToTreadmill)
                                atTreadmill = ok and result == true
                            end
                            if atTreadmill then
                                useTreadmill()
                                refreshTreadmillESP()
                                waitTime = 0.15
                            else
                                refreshTreadmillESP()
                                waitTime = activeTween and 0.05 or 0.1
                            end
                        end
                    elseif autoStealPhase == "BEST" then
                        -- ============================================================
                        -- BEST LOCKED MODE
                        -- Once we rush for the best egg we STAY collecting the best
                        -- egg. If the best egg is lost we simply re-lock onto the
                        -- new best egg - we NEVER restart the nearest->best flow.
                        -- We ONLY go back to start (nearest loop) when the egg is
                        -- confirmed in our inventory (carrying == true) and it has
                        -- been returned/deposited.
                        -- ============================================================
                                            if carrying then
                            collectionAttempts = 0
                            if currentStealState ~= StealState.RETURNING and currentStealState ~= StealState.DEPOSITING then
                                currentStealState = StealState.RETURNING
                                cancelActiveTween()
                                tweenCharacterTo(getReturnPosition(), _G.DiabloState.AutoStealSpeed)
                            elseif currentStealState == StealState.RETURNING and isAtPosition(getReturnPosition(), 12) then
                                cancelActiveTween()
                                currentStealState = StealState.DEPOSITING
                            end
                                                                                    elseif currentStealState == StealState.DEPOSITING then
                            if carrying then
                                -- Still holding at return point, wait
                                waitTime = 0.1
                            else
                                -- Egg successfully returned: full reset to beginning cycle
                                bestLocked = false
                                autoStealPhase = "NEAREST"
                                currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
                                targetUid = nil
                                collectionAttempts = 0
                                resetCarryDetection()
                                waitTime = 0.3
                            end
                                            elseif currentStealState == StealState.RETURNING then
                            if carrying then
                                -- Egg still in inventory on return trip -> keep going
                                if isAtPosition(getReturnPosition(), 12) then
                                    cancelActiveTween()
                                    currentStealState = StealState.DEPOSITING
                                end
                            else
                                -- Egg lost on the way back -> re-rush best, do NOT restart nearest loop
                                cancelActiveTween()
                                autoStealPhase = "BEST"
                                currentStealState = StealState.RAGDOLLED_RUSH
                                targetUid = nil
                                collectionAttempts = 0
                                resetCarryDetection()
                            end
                            waitTime = 0.1

                        else
                            -- Collect the best egg as much as possible
                            refreshCarriedEggsCache()
                            local bestUid = findBestEgg(true)
                            if bestUid and _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[bestUid] then
                                targetUid = bestUid
                                local data = _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[bestUid]
                                local bp = data.basePart or getModelBasePart(data.model)
                                data.basePart = bp

                                if bp and bp.Parent then
                                    if carriedEggsCache[bestUid] then
                                        waitTime = 0.15
                                    elseif isAtPosition(bp.Position, 8) then
                                        currentStealState = StealState.COLLECTING_BEST
                                        collectionAttempts = collectionAttempts + 1
                                        if collectionAttempts > 75 then
                                            -- Prompt seems dead, nudge position but STAY locked
                                            collectionAttempts = 0
                                            cancelActiveTween()
                                            tweenCharacterTo(bp.Position + Vector3.new(2, 0, 2), 100000)
                                        else
                                            local fired, newLast = firePromptForUid(bestUid, lastPromptFire, promptFireInterval)
                                            lastPromptFire = newLast
                                            if not fired then
                                                cancelActiveTween()
                                                tweenCharacterTo(bp.Position, 100000)
                                                currentStealState = StealState.MOVING_TO_BEST
                                            end
                                        end
                                        waitTime = 0.08
                                    else
                                        currentStealState = StealState.MOVING_TO_BEST
                                        if not activeTween then
                                            tweenCharacterTo(bp.Position, 100000)
                                        end
                                        waitTime = 0.03
                                    end
                                else
                                    waitTime = 0.1
                                end
                            else
                                -- No best egg available right now. STAY locked,
                                -- never fall back to the nearest-egg loop.
                                waitTime = 0.2
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        -- ============================================================
                        -- NORMAL MODE: nearest egg first, wait, then lock best
                        -- ============================================================
                        if autoStealPhase == "NEAREST" and currentStealState == StealState.IDLE then
                            bestLocked = false
                            targetUid = nil
                            collectionAttempts = 0
                            local nearestUid = findNearestEgg()
                            if nearestUid and _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[nearestUid] then
                                local data = _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[nearestUid]
                                local bp = data.basePart or getModelBasePart(data.model)
                                data.basePart = bp
                                if bp then
                                    targetUid = nearestUid
                                    collectionAttempts = 0
                                    currentStealState = StealState.MOVING_TO_EGG
                                    tweenCharacterTo(bp.Position, 240)
                                end
                            else
                                waitTime = 0.2
                            end

                        elseif currentStealState == StealState.MOVING_TO_EGG then
                            if carrying then
                                currentStealState = StealState.WAITING
                                cancelActiveTween()
                            elseif not targetUid or not _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[targetUid] or carriedEggsCache[targetUid] then
                                currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
                                cancelActiveTween()
                                targetUid = nil
                            else

                                if bp and bp.Parent and isAtPosition(bp.Position, 8) then
                                    cancelActiveTween()
                                    collectionAttempts = 0
                                    currentStealState = StealState.COLLECTING
                                end
                            end

                        elseif currentStealState == StealState.COLLECTING then
                            if carrying then
                                collectionAttempts = 0
                                currentStealState = StealState.WAITING
                                cancelActiveTween()
                            elseif not targetUid or not _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[targetUid] then
                                currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
                                cancelActiveTween()
                                targetUid = nil
                            else
                                collectionAttempts = collectionAttempts + 1
                                if collectionAttempts <= maxCollectionAttempts then
                                    local fired, newLast = firePromptForUid(targetUid, lastPromptFire, promptFireInterval)
                                    lastPromptFire = newLast
                                    if not fired then
                                        local data = _G.DiabloState.trackedEggs[targetUid]
                                        local bp = data.basePart or getModelBasePart(data.model)
                                        if bp then
                                            tweenCharacterTo(bp.Position, 240)
                                        end
                                    end
                                    waitTime = 0.08
                                else
                                    currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
                                    cancelActiveTween()
                                    targetUid = nil
                                    collectionAttempts = 0
                                end
                            end

                        elseif currentStealState == StealState.WAITING then
                            if ragdolled then
                                bestLocked = true
                                autoStealPhase = "BEST"
                                targetUid = nil
                                collectionAttempts = 0
                                currentStealState = StealState.RAGDOLLED_RUSH
                                cancelActiveTween()
                            end

                                                                                    elseif currentStealState == StealState.DEPOSITING then
                            if carrying then
                                -- Still holding at return point, wait
                                waitTime = 0.1
                            else
                                -- Egg successfully returned: full reset to beginning cycle
                                bestLocked = false
                                autoStealPhase = "NEAREST"
                                currentStealState = StealState.IDLE
                                targetUid = nil
                                collectionAttempts = 0
                                resetCarryDetection()

                                currentStealState = StealState.RAGDOLLED_RUSH
                                targetUid = nil
                                collectionAttempts = 0
                                resetCarryDetection()
                            end

                        end
                    end

                    task.wait(waitTime)
                end

                _G.DiabloState.autoLoopRunning = false
                resetTreadmillPath()
                cancelActiveTween()
                currentStealState = StealState.IDLE

    local GCHookBypass = {
        RunService = RunService,
        Players = Players,
        speedconn = nil,
        hookedfunc3 = nil,
    }

    function GCHookBypass:collectgarbage()
        local s, r = pcall(function(...)
            return getgc()
        end)
        if s and r then
            return r    
        end
        return warn("failed to get garbage: "..tostring(r))
    end

    function GCHookBypass:safehook(f, c)
        local s, r = pcall(function(...)
            return hookfunction(f, newlclosure(c))
        end)
        if s and r then
            return r    
        end
        return warn("failed to hook function: "..tostring(r))
    end

    function GCHookBypass:findfunction(nups, linedefined)
        local s, r = pcall(function(...)
            for _, f in next, self:collectgarbage() do
                if typeof(f) == 'function' and islclosure(f) then
                    local upvs = debug.getupvalues(f)
                    local line = debug.info(f, "l")

                    if upvs and #upvs == nups and line == linedefined then
                        if nups == 10 then
                            local t = debug.getupvalue(f, 3)
                            if typeof(t) == "table" and rawget(t, "Humanoid") then
                                return f
                            end
                        else
                            return f
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            return nil
        end)
        if s and r then
            return r
        end
        return nil
    end

    function GCHookBypass:init()
        self.LocalPlayer = self.Players.LocalPlayer
        if not self.LocalPlayer then
            return warn("failed to get localplayer")
        end

        if not getgc then
            self.LocalPlayer:Kick("UNSUPPORT EXECUTOR MISSING getgc")
        end

        if not hookfunction then
            self.LocalPlayer:Kick("UNSUPPORT EXECUTOR MISSING hookfunction")
        end

        if not islclosure then
            self.LocalPlayer:Kick("UNSUPPORT EXECUTOR MISSING islclosure")
        end

        local func3 = self:findfunction(19, 3)
        if not func3 then
            return warn("failed to get function 3")
        end

        local v7 = debug.getupvalue(func3, 2)
        if not v7 then
            return warn("failed to get v7")
        end

        self.hookedfunc3 = self:safehook(v7, function(p1, p2)
            if p2 and typeof(p2) == "table" then
                setmetatable(p2, {})
            end
            return self.hookedfunc3(p1,p2)
        end)

        self.speedconn = self.RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            local char = self.LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then 
                return
            end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if not hum then 
                return
            end
            hum.WalkSpeed = _G.DiabloState.DesiredSpeed
        end)

        warn("[GC Hook Bypass] Initialized")
        return true
    end

    function GCHookBypass:stop()
        if self.speedconn then
            pcall(function() self.speedconn:Disconnect() end)
            self.speedconn = nil
        end
        warn("[GC Hook Bypass] Stopped")
    end

    local function startGCHookBypass()
        GCHookBypass:init()
    end

    local function stopGCHookBypass()
        GCHookBypass:stop()
    end

    local function forceWalkSpeedNewBypass(humanoid)
        if newBypassConnections[humanoid] then
            pcall(function() newBypassConnections[humanoid]:Disconnect() end)
        end
        newBypassConnections[humanoid] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if humanoid and humanoid.Parent then
                if humanoid.WalkSpeed ~= _G.DiabloState.DesiredSpeed then
                    humanoid.WalkSpeed = _G.DiabloState.DesiredSpeed
                end
            else
                if newBypassConnections[humanoid] then
                    newBypassConnections[humanoid]:Disconnect()
                    newBypassConnections[humanoid] = nil
                end
            end
        end)
    end

    local function applyNewBypass(character)
        local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not humanoid then return end

        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local animateScript = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
        local jumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
        local jumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight
        local health = humanoid.Health
        local maxHealth = humanoid.MaxHealth

        if animateScript and animateScript:IsA("LocalScript") then
            animateScript.Disabled = true
        end

        local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
        if animator then
            for _, track in next, animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks() do
                track:Stop(0)
            end
        end

        humanoid.Archivable = true
        local newHumanoid = humanoid:Clone()
        for _, child in next, newHumanoid:GetChildren() do
            if child:IsA("Animator") then
                child:Destroy()
            end
        end

        humanoid.Name = "_OldHumanoid"
        newHumanoid.Name = "Humanoid"
        newHumanoid.Parent = character

        local newAnimator = Instance.new("Animator")
        newAnimator.Parent = newHumanoid

        newHumanoid.WalkSpeed = _G.DiabloState.DesiredSpeed
        newHumanoid.JumpPower = jumpPower
        newHumanoid.JumpHeight = jumpHeight
        newHumanoid.MaxHealth = maxHealth
        newHumanoid.Health = math.min(health, maxHealth)

        if camera then
            camera.CameraSubject = newHumanoid
        end

        humanoid:Destroy()

        if animateScript and animateScript:IsA("LocalScript") then
            task.wait()
            animateScript.Disabled = false
            task.defer(function()
                if animateScript.Parent then
                    animateScript.Disabled = true
                    task.wait()
                    animateScript.Disabled = false
                end
            end)
        end

        task.defer(function()
            if newHumanoid.Parent then
                newHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
            end
        end)

        forceWalkSpeedNewBypass(newHumanoid)
        _G.DiabloState.CurrentHumanoid = newHumanoid
        return newHumanoid
    end

    local function setupNewBypass(character)
        character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
        task.wait()
        applyNewBypass(character)
    end

        _G.DiabloState.FlyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            if not _G.DiabloState.FlyEnabled then return end
            if not (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then return end
            local currentHrp = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
            local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
            local direction = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
                direction = direction + cam.CFrame.LookVector
            end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
                direction = direction - cam.CFrame.LookVector
            end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
                direction = direction - cam.CFrame.RightVector
            end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
                direction = direction + cam.CFrame.RightVector
            end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
                direction = direction + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            end
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
                direction = direction - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
            end

            if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
                direction = direction.Unit * _G.DiabloState.FlySpeed
            end

            if _G.DiabloState.FlyBodyGyro and _G.DiabloState.FlyBodyGyro.Parent then
                _G.DiabloState.FlyBodyGyro.CFrame = cam.CFrame
            end
            if _G.DiabloState.FlyBodyVelocity and _G.DiabloState.FlyBodyVelocity.Parent then
                _G.DiabloState.FlyBodyVelocity.Velocity = direction
            end
        end)
    end

    local function storeJoints(character)
        joints = {}
        for _, joint in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
                joints[joint.Name] = {
                    Part0 = joint.Part0,
                    Part1 = joint.Part1,
                    C0 = joint.C0,
                    C1 = joint.C1
                }
            end
        end
    end

    local function restoreJoints(character)
        for name, data in pairs(joints) do
            if data.Part0 and data.Part1 then
                local existing = data.Part0:FindFirstChild(name)
                if existing and existing:IsA("Motor6D") then
                    existing.Part0 = data.Part0
                    existing.Part1 = data.Part1
                    existing.C0 = data.C0
                    existing.C1 = data.C1
                elseif not existing then
                    local joint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
                    joint.Name = name
                    joint.Part0 = data.Part0
                    joint.Part1 = data.Part1
                    joint.C0 = data.C0
                    joint.C1 = data.C1
                    joint.Parent = data.Part0
                end
            end
        end
    end

            local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
            if targetPlayer then
                createDiabloBillboard(targetPlayer)
            end
        end

        local function onUserMarkerRemoved(marker)
            local userId = tonumber(marker.Name)
            if not userId then return end
            local targetPlayer = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
            if targetPlayer then
                removeDiabloBillboard(targetPlayer)
            end
        end

        local myMarkerName = tostring(player.UserId)
        local existingMarker = DiabloUsersFolder:FindFirstChild(myMarkerName)
        if existingMarker then
            pcall(function() existingMarker:Destroy() end)
        end

        local myMarker = Instance.new("BoolValue")
        myMarker.Name = myMarkerName
        myMarker.Value = true
        myMarker.Parent = DiabloUsersFolder

        for _, marker in ipairs(DiabloUsersFolder:GetChildren()) do
            onUserMarkerAdded(marker)
        end

        DiabloUsersFolder.ChildAdded:Connect(onUserMarkerAdded)
        DiabloUsersFolder.ChildRemoved:Connect(onUserMarkerRemoved)

        Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
            if plr == player then
                pcall(function()
                    local m = DiabloUsersFolder:FindFirstChild(myMarkerName)
                    if m then m:Destroy() end
                end)
            else
                removeDiabloBillboard(plr)
            end
        end)
    end

    local batAuraConnection = nil
    local batAuraLastSwing = 0

    local BatAuraSwingRemote = nil
    local BatAuraToolGameplayGuard = nil

    local function initBatAuraRefs()
        BatAuraSwingRemote = nil
        BatAuraToolGameplayGuard = nil

        local packages = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
        if not packages then
            warn("[Bat Aura] Packages folder not found in ReplicatedStorage")
            return false
        end

        local networking = packages:FindFirstChild("Networking")
        if not networking then
            warn("[Bat Aura] Networking folder not found in Packages")
            return false
        end

        BatAuraSwingRemote = networking:FindFirstChild("RE/BatSwing/Trigger")
        if not BatAuraSwingRemote then
            warn("[Bat Aura] RE/BatSwing/Trigger remote not found")
            return false
        end

        local client = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Client")
        if client then
            local guardModule = client:FindFirstChild("ToolGameplayGuard")
            if guardModule then
                local ok, result = pcall(require, guardModule)
                if ok and result then
                    BatAuraToolGameplayGuard = result
                else
                    warn("[Bat Aura] ToolGameplayGuard require failed: " .. tostring(result))
                end
            else
                warn("[Bat Aura] ToolGameplayGuard module not found")
            end
        else
            warn("[Bat Aura] Client folder not found")
        end

        return true
    end

    local function batAuraCreateSeed()
        local s, r = pcall(function()
            return ("%*:%*:%*"):format(LocalPlayer.UserId, 100, math.floor(Workspace:GetServerTimeNow() * 1000))
        end)
        if s and r then return r end
        return nil
    end

    local function batAuraCanUseTool()
        local s, r = pcall(function()
            local c = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not c then return false end

            local t = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if not t or t:GetAttribute("ItemType") ~= "Gear" then
                return false
            end

            local h = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not h then return false end

            if BatAuraToolGameplayGuard and BatAuraToolGameplayGuard.IsLocalInsideArena then
                local n = not BatAuraToolGameplayGuard.IsLocalInsideArena()
                if n then return false end
            end

            if Workspace:GetAttribute("Event_MonsterEvent") then
                return -268 < h.Position.Z
            end
            return true
        end)
        if s and r then return r end
        return false
    end

    local function batAuraGetClosestPlayer()
        local c = nil
        local cd = math.huge
        for _, p in next, Players:GetPlayers() do
            if p == LocalPlayer then continue end
            local char = p.Character
            if not char then continue end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not hrp then continue end
            local dist = LocalPlayer:DistanceFromCharacter(hrp.Position)
            if dist < cd and dist <= 16.5 then
                cd = dist
                c = p
            end
        end
        return c
    end

    local function batAuraAttack(targetPlayer)
        if not BatAuraSwingRemote then return end
        local s, r = pcall(function()
            return BatAuraSwingRemote:FireServer(targetPlayer, batAuraCreateSeed())
        end)
        if not s then
            warn("[Bat Aura] Attack error: " .. tostring(r))
        end
    end

    local function startBatAura()
        if batAuraConnection then
            pcall(function() batAuraConnection:Disconnect() end)
            batAuraConnection = nil
        end

        if not initBatAuraRefs() then
            warn("[Bat Aura] Initialization failed. Toggle off and on again after game loads fully.")
            return
        end

        batAuraConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
            if not _G.DiabloState.BatAuraEnabled then return end
            if not BatAuraSwingRemote then return end

            local now = tick()
            if now - batAuraLastSwing < 0.1 then return end

            local target = batAuraGetClosestPlayer()
            if not target then return end

            if batAuraCanUseTool() then
                batAuraAttack(target)
                batAuraLastSwing = now
            end
        end)

        warn("[Bat Aura] Started")
    end

    local function stopBatAura()
        if batAuraConnection then
            pcall(function() batAuraConnection:Disconnect() end)
            batAuraConnection = nil
        end
        warn("[Bat Aura] Stopped")
    end

    if _G.DiabloState.BatAuraEnabled then
        task.spawn(function()
            task.wait(2)
            startBatAura()
        end)
    end

    if _G.DiabloState.SpeedEnabled then
        startNewBypass()
    end

    local AutoSellUtility = {
        ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    }

    function AutoSellUtility:init()
        self.Shared = self.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared")
        if not self.Shared then
            return warn("[Auto Sell] failed to get Shared")
        end

        self.Data = self.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Data")
        if not self.Data then
            return warn("[Auto Sell] failed to get Data")
        end

        self.Save = require(self.Shared:FindFirstChild("Save"))
        if not self.Save then
            return warn("[Auto Sell] failed to get Save")
        end

        self.Assets = require(self.Data:FindFirstChild("Assets"))
        if not self.Assets then
            return warn("[Auto Sell] failed to get Assets")
        end

        self.Packages = self.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
        if not self.Packages then
            return warn("[Auto Sell] failed to get Packages")
        end

        self.Networking = self.Packages:FindFirstChild("Networking")
        if not self.Networking then
            return warn("[Auto Sell] failed to get Networking")
        end

        self.AskWearTool = self.Networking:FindFirstChild("RF/EggWorld/AskWearTool")
        if not self.AskWearTool then
            return warn("[Auto Sell] failed to get RF/EggWorld/AskWearTool")
        end

        self.SellPet = self.Networking:FindFirstChild("RE/PetSatchel/SellPet")
        if not self.SellPet then
            return warn("[Auto Sell] failed to get RE/PetSatchel/SellPet")
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            while true do
                task.wait(1)
                if not _G.DiabloState.AutoSellEnabled then continue end

                local success, err = pcall(function()
                    local data = self.Save.Get()
                    if not data then return end
                    local inv = data.EggInventory
                    if not inv then return end

                    for Uid, eggdata in next, inv do
                        if not _G.DiabloState.AutoSellEnabled then break end
                        if eggdata.Placement then continue end

                        local assetInfo = self.Assets.Directory[eggdata.AssetCategory]
                        if not assetInfo then continue end
                        local rarity = assetInfo.Rarity
                        if not rarity then continue end

                        local rarityName = rarity.DisplayName or rarity.Name or "Unknown"
                        if table.find(_G.DiabloState.AutoSellRarities, rarityName) then
                            pcall(function()
                                self.AskWearTool:InvokeServer(Uid)
                            end)
                            task.wait(0.05)
                            pcall(function()
                                self.SellPet:FireServer({Uid})
                            end)
                            task.wait(0.1)
                        end
                    end
                end)

                if not success then
                    warn("[Auto Sell] Error: " .. tostring(err))
                end
            end
        end)

        warn("[Auto Sell] Initialized successfully")
    end

    AutoSellUtility:init()

    _G.DiabloUpgradeUtility = _G.DiabloUpgradeUtility or {
        ReplicatedStorage = ReplicatedStorage,
    }

    function _G.DiabloUpgradeUtility:GetTreadmils()
        local s, r = pcall(function()
            local d = self.Save.Get()
            local o = {}
            if not d or not self.Treadmills then return o end
            local l = d.TreadmillUpgradeLevel
            for id, t in next, self.Treadmills.Directory do
                if self.Treadmills.GetUpgradeLevel(id) > l and self.CanAfford(d.Money, t.Price) then
                    table.insert(o, id)
                end
            end
            return o
        end)
        if s and r then return r end
        return nil
    end

    function _G.DiabloUpgradeUtility:GetBaseUpgradeable()
        local s, r = pcall(function()
            local d = self.Save.Get()
            if not d then return false end
            local l = d.BaseUpgradeLevel + 1
            local n = self.Bases.BASES[l]
            if not n then return false end
            return self.CanAfford(d.Money, n.Cost)
        end)
        if s and r then return r end
        return false
    end

    function _G.DiabloUpgradeUtility:GetTrails()
        local s, r = pcall(function()
            local d = self.Save.Get()
            local o = {}
            if not d or not self.Trails then return o end
            for _, trial in next, self.Trails.Directory do
                if not d.TrailInventory[trial._id] and self.CanAfford(d.Money, trial.Price) then
                    table.insert(o, trial._id)
                end
            end
            return o
        end)
        if s and r then return r end
        return nil
    end

    _G.DiabloUpgradeUtility.CanAfford = function(m, c)
        local s, r = pcall(function()
            return m >= c
        end)
        if s and r then return r end
        return false
    end

    function _G.DiabloUpgradeUtility:Purchase(remote, id)
        local s, r = pcall(function()
            return remote:InvokeServer(id)
        end)
        if s and r then return r end
        return false
    end

    function _G.DiabloUpgradeUtility:Init()
        self.Data = self.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Data")
        if not self.Data then return warn("Couldnt get data") end

        self.Treadmills = require(self.Data:FindFirstChild("Treadmills"))
        if not self.Treadmills then return warn("failed to get Treadmills") end

        self.Trails = require(self.Data:FindFirstChild("Trails"))
        if not self.Trails then return warn("Couldnt get Trails") end

        self.Bases = require(self.Data:FindFirstChild("Bases"))
        if not self.Bases then return warn("Couldnt get Bases") end

        self.Shared = self.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Shared")
        if not self.Shared then return warn("couldnt get Shared") end

        self.Save = require(self.Shared:FindFirstChild("Save"))
        if not self.Save then return warn("couldnt get Save") end

        self.Packages = self.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Packages")
        if not self.Packages then return warn("couldnt get Packages") end

        self.Networking = self.Packages:FindFirstChild("Networking")
        if not self.Networking then return warn("couldnt get Networking") end

        self["RF/Trailwear/AskPurchase"] = self.Networking:FindFirstChild("RF/Trailwear/AskPurchase")
        if not self["RF/Trailwear/AskPurchase"] then return warn("couldnt get RF/Trailwear/AskPurchase") end

        self["RF/Treadmill/AskTierRaise"] = self.Networking:FindFirstChild("RF/Treadmill/AskTierRaise")
        if not self["RF/Treadmill/AskTierRaise"] then return warn("couldnt get RF/Treadmill/AskTierRaise") end

        self["RE/Homestead/AskBaseTierRaise"] = self.Networking:FindFirstChild("RE/Homestead/AskBaseTierRaise")
        if not self["RE/Homestead/AskBaseTierRaise"] then return warn("couldnt get RE/Homestead/AskBaseTierRaise") end

        if self._Running then return true end
        self._Running = true

        task.spawn(function()
            while task.wait(0.1) do
                local trials = self:GetTrails()
                if typeof(trials) == "table" then
                    for _, trail in next, trials do
                        self:Purchase(self["RF/Trailwear/AskPurchase"], trail)
                        task.wait(0.1)
                    end
                end

                local treadmils = self:GetTreadmils()
                if typeof(treadmils) == "table" then
                    for _, treadmil in next, treadmils do
                        self:Purchase(self["RF/Treadmill/AskTierRaise"], treadmil)
                        task.wait(0.1)
                    end
                end

                if self:GetBaseUpgradeable() then
                    pcall(function()
                        self["RE/Homestead/AskBaseTierRaise"]:FireServer()
                    end)
                end
            end
        end)
        return true
    end

    _G.DiabloUpgradeUtility:Init()

    wait(5)
    local Players = game:GetService("Players")
    local player = Players.LocalPlayer
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

    -- Guardamos la posición original de las articulaciones
    local joints = {}
    for _, joint in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
        if joint:IsA("Motor6D") then
            joints[joint.Name] = {Part0 = joint.Part0, Part1 = joint.Part1, C0 = joint.C0, C1 = joint.C1}
        end
    end

    -- Función para restaurar joints
    local function restoreJoints()
        for name, data in pairs(joints) do
            if data.Part0:FindFirstChild(name) == nil then
                local joint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
                joint.Name = name
                joint.Part0 = data.Part0
                joint.Part1 = data.Part1
                joint.C0 = data.C0
                joint.C1 = data.C1
                joint.Parent = data.Part0
            end
        end
    end

    -- Previene la caída (ragdoll) cada frame
    game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics or
        humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall or
        humanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Seated then
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running)
            restoreJoints()
        end
    end)

--==============================================================
-- daparada777 Hub
--
-- K          = open / close menu
--
-- MAIN       = fly / speed hack / noclip / infinite jump / jump power
-- TELEPORT   = player selection + teleport / fly-to-player
-- VISUALS    = ESP / names / distance / tracers
-- AVATAR     = R6 conversion
-- SETTINGS   = interface settings
-- MISC       = universal utilities / server / character
--==============================================================

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local VirtualUser = game:GetService("VirtualUser")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

--==============================================================
-- STATE
--==============================================================

local Unloaded = false
local OpenState = false
local StartClock = os.clock()

local Connections = {}
local PlayerConnections = {}
local ESPObjects = {}

local R6ConversionBusy = false

--==============================================================
-- CONFIG
--==============================================================

local Config = {
    MenuKey = Enum.KeyCode.K,

    Sounds = true,
    Blur = true,
    AnimSpeed = 1,

    ThemeName = "Red",
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 86),

    ESPEnabled = false,
    NamesEnabled = true,
    DistanceEnabled = true,
    TracersEnabled = true,
    ESPColor = Color3.fromRGB(120, 210, 255),

    FlyEnabled = false,
    FlySpeed = 100,

    SpeedHackEnabled = false,
    SpeedHack = 100,

    NoclipEnabled = false,
    InfiniteJumpEnabled = false,
    JumpPower = 50,

    TeleportMode = "Teleport",

    AntiAFKEnabled = false,
    FullBrightEnabled = false,
    SavedPosition = nil,
    Spectating = false,
}

local Themes = {
    Red = {
        Bg = Color3.fromRGB(20, 10, 13),
        Glass = Color3.fromRGB(31, 14, 20),
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(42, 19, 27),
        CardHi = Color3.fromRGB(57, 24, 34),
        Field = Color3.fromRGB(32, 15, 22),
        Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(118, 58, 72),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 236, 240),
        Sub = Color3.fromRGB(177, 145, 154),
        Off = Color3.fromRGB(76, 48, 57),
        White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Ok = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 150),
        Warn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 80),
        Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 75, 86),
    },

    Black = {
        Bg = Color3.fromRGB(8, 9, 12),
        Glass = Color3.fromRGB(14, 16, 21),
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(20, 23, 29),
        CardHi = Color3.fromRGB(31, 35, 43),
        Field = Color3.fromRGB(16, 18, 24),
        Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(57, 63, 75),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(240, 243, 247),
        Sub = Color3.fromRGB(150, 158, 170),
        Off = Color3.fromRGB(63, 68, 78),
        White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Ok = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 150),
        Warn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 80),
        Accent = Color3.fromRGB(220, 225, 235),
    },

    ["Dark Blue"] = {
        Bg = Color3.fromRGB(8, 13, 22),
        Glass = Color3.fromRGB(12, 20, 33),
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(18, 28, 47),
        CardHi = Color3.fromRGB(25, 40, 65),
        Field = Color3.fromRGB(14, 24, 40),
        Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(50, 76, 110),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(232, 241, 250),
        Sub = Color3.fromRGB(137, 158, 183),
        Off = Color3.fromRGB(48, 63, 82),
        White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Ok = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 150),
        Warn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 80),
        Accent = Color3.fromRGB(72, 150, 255),
    },

    ["Pink Purple"] = {
        Bg = Color3.fromRGB(16, 9, 22),
        Glass = Color3.fromRGB(25, 12, 34),
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(36, 17, 49),
        CardHi = Color3.fromRGB(52, 25, 69),
        Field = Color3.fromRGB(28, 14, 38),
        Stroke = Color3.fromRGB(93, 64, 116),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 238, 250),
        Sub = Color3.fromRGB(173, 149, 190),
        Off = Color3.fromRGB(76, 57, 90),
        White = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Ok = Color3.fromRGB(90, 220, 150),
        Warn = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 80),
        Accent = Color3.fromRGB(225, 103, 255),
    },
}

local Theme = Themes[Config.ThemeName]

--==============================================================
-- FLY STATE
--==============================================================

local FlyVelocity = nil
local FlyAttachment = nil
local FlyOrientation = nil

local NoclipOriginals = {}
local InfiniteJumpHeld = false
local OriginalJumpPower = nil
local OriginalJumpHeight = nil
local OriginalUseJumpPower = nil
local JumpPowerConfigured = false

local AntiCheatBypassEnabled = false
local AntiCheatRemovedHumanoid = nil
local AntiCheatSavedCameraSubject = nil
local AntiCheatSavedCameraType = nil

local SelectedPlayer = nil
local TeleportMode = "Teleport"
local TeleportFlightActive = false
local TeleportFlightTarget = nil
local TeleportFlightConnection = nil
local TeleportFlightToken = 0
local TeleportFlightKeptManualFly = false

local OriginalLighting = {
    Brightness = nil,
    ClockTime = nil,
    FogEnd = nil,
    GlobalShadows = nil,
    Ambient = nil,
    OutdoorAmbient = nil,
}

local SavedCameraSubject = nil
local SavedCameraType = nil
local SpectateConnection = nil
local FullBrightApplied = false
local AntiAFKConnection = nil

local StartFlyToPlayer
local StopFlyToPlayer
local RefreshTeleportModeButtons
local SelectPlayerButton
local PlayerPopup

--==============================================================
-- HELPERS
--==============================================================

local function Connect(signal, callback)
    local c = signal:Connect(callback)
    table.insert(Connections, c)
    return c
end

local function New(className, props)
    local object = Instance.new(className)

    for key, value in pairs(props or {}) do
        object[key] = value
    end

    local function MarkBackgroundRole(color)
        if not color then
            return
        end

        if color == Theme.Bg then object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole", "Bg") end
        if color == Theme.Glass then object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole", "Glass") end
        if color == Theme.Card then object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole", "Card") end
        if color == Theme.CardHi then object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole", "CardHi") end
        if color == Theme.Field then object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole", "Field") end
        if color == Theme.Off then object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole", "Off") end
        if color == Theme.White then object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole", "White") end
        if color == Theme.Ok then object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole", "Ok") end
        if color == Theme.Warn then object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole", "Warn") end
        if color == Config.Accent or color == Theme.Accent then
            object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole", "Accent")
        end
    end

    if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
        MarkBackgroundRole(object.BackgroundColor3)

        if object:IsA("TextLabel")
            or object:IsA("TextButton")
            or object:IsA("TextBox") then

            if object.TextColor3 == Theme.Text then
                object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeTextRole", "Text")
            elseif object.TextColor3 == Theme.Sub then
                object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeTextRole", "Sub")
            elseif object.TextColor3 == Config.Accent
                or object.TextColor3 == Theme.Accent then

                object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeTextRole", "Accent")
            elseif object.TextColor3 == Theme.White then
                object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeTextRole", "White")
            end
        end
    elseif object:IsA("UIStroke") then
        if object.Color == Theme.Stroke then
            object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeStrokeRole", "Stroke")
        elseif object.Color == Config.Accent or object.Color == Theme.Accent then
            object:SetAttribute("BoBThemeStrokeRole", "Accent")
        end
    end

    return object
end

local function Corner(object, radius)
    local c = New("UICorner", {
        CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius)
    })

    c.Parent = object

    return c
end

local function Stroke(object, color, thickness, transparency)
    local s = New("UIStroke", {
        Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(70, 90, 120),
        Thickness = thickness or 1,
        Transparency = transparency or 0
    })

    s.Parent = object

    return s
end

local function Tween(object, time, goal, style, direction)
    local duration =
        time / math.max(Config.AnimSpeed, 0.1)

    local t = TweenService:Create(
        object,
        TweenInfo.new(
            duration,
            style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,
            direction or Enum.EasingDirection.Out
        ),
        goal
    )

    t:Play()

    return t
end

local function GetCharacter()
    return LocalPlayer.Character
end

local function GetRoot()
    local character = GetCharacter()

    if not character then
        return nil
    end

    return character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function GetHumanoid()
    local character = GetCharacter()

    if not character then
        return nil
    end

    return character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

--==============================================================
-- MOVEMENT UTILITIES
--==============================================================

local function RestoreNoclip()
    for part, original in pairs(NoclipOriginals) do
        if part and part.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                part.CanCollide = original
            end)
        end
    end

    table.clear(NoclipOriginals)
end

local function ApplyJumpPower()
    local humanoid = GetHumanoid()
    if not humanoid then
        return
    end

    if OriginalJumpPower == nil then
        OriginalJumpPower = humanoid.JumpPower
        OriginalJumpHeight = humanoid.JumpHeight
        OriginalUseJumpPower = humanoid.UseJumpPower
    end

    pcall(function()
        humanoid.UseJumpPower = true
        humanoid.JumpPower = math.clamp(Config.JumpPower, 0, 500)
    end)
end

local function RestoreJumpPower()
    local humanoid = GetHumanoid()
    if not humanoid then
        return
    end

    if OriginalJumpPower ~= nil then
        pcall(function()
            humanoid.JumpPower = OriginalJumpPower
        end)
    end

    if OriginalJumpHeight ~= nil then
        pcall(function()
            humanoid.JumpHeight = OriginalJumpHeight
        end)
    end

    if OriginalUseJumpPower ~= nil then
        pcall(function()
            humanoid.UseJumpPower = OriginalUseJumpPower
        end)
    end

    OriginalJumpPower = nil
    OriginalJumpHeight = nil
    OriginalUseJumpPower = nil
end

local NoclipAccumulator = 0

Connect(
    RunService.Heartbeat,
    function(deltaTime)
        if Unloaded or not Config.NoclipEnabled then
            return
        end

        NoclipAccumulator += deltaTime
        if NoclipAccumulator < 0.10 then
            return
        end
        NoclipAccumulator = 0

        local character = GetCharacter()
        if not character then
            return
        end

        for _, object in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if object:IsA("BasePart") then
                if NoclipOriginals[object] == nil then
                    NoclipOriginals[object] = object.CanCollide
                end

                if object.CanCollide then
                    object.CanCollide = false
                end
            end
        end
    end
)

Connect(
    UserInputService.InputBegan,
    function(input, gameProcessed)
        if Unloaded or gameProcessed then
            return
        end

        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
            InfiniteJumpHeld = true
        end
    end
)

Connect(
    UserInputService.InputEnded,
    function(input)
        if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space then
            InfiniteJumpHeld = false
        end
    end
)

Connect(
    RunService.Heartbeat,
    function()
        if Unloaded or not Config.InfiniteJumpEnabled or not InfiniteJumpHeld then
            return
        end

        local humanoid = GetHumanoid()
        local root = GetRoot()

        if not root then
            return
        end

        if Config.JumpPower <= 0 then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
            local velocity = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(
                velocity.X,
                Config.JumpPower,
                velocity.Z
            )
        end)
    end
)

        Tween(

            },
            Enum.EasingStyle.Back
        )

        tab.Text.TextColor3 =
            active
            and Theme.Text
            or Theme.Sub
    end

    for pageName, page in pairs(Pages) do
        page.Visible = pageName == name
    end

--==============================================================
-- THEME SYSTEM
--==============================================================

local function ApplyTheme(name)
    local selected = Themes[name]
    if not selected then
        return false
    end

    Config.ThemeName = name
    Theme = selected
    Config.Accent = Theme.Accent

    for _, object in ipairs(Gui:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("GuiObject") then
            local bgRole = object:GetAttribute("BoBThemeBgRole")
            local textRole = object:GetAttribute("BoBThemeTextRole")

            if bgRole and Theme[bgRole] then
                object.BackgroundColor3 = Theme[bgRole]
            end

            if (object:IsA("TextLabel")
                or object:IsA("TextButton")
                or object:IsA("TextBox"))
                and textRole
                and Theme[textRole] then

                object.TextColor3 = Theme[textRole]
            end
        elseif object:IsA("UIStroke") then
            local strokeRole = object:GetAttribute("BoBThemeStrokeRole")
            if strokeRole and Theme[strokeRole] then
                object.Color = Theme[strokeRole]
            end
        end
    end

    Main.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Bg
    Water.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Glass

    if SelectPlayerButton then
        local selectedRole =
            SelectedPlayer and SelectedPlayer.Parent and "Text" or "Sub"

        SelectPlayerButton:SetAttribute(
            "BoBThemeTextRole",
            selectedRole
        )

        SelectPlayerButton.TextColor3 =
            selectedRole == "Text" and Theme.Text or Theme.Sub
    end
    MainStroke.Color = Theme.Stroke:Lerp(Theme.Accent, 0.35)
    LogoDot.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
    WatermarkDot.BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent
    TitleGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new(Theme.Text, Theme.Accent)

    WaterGradient.Color = ColorSequence.new({
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Theme.Text),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Theme.Accent:Lerp(Theme.Text, 0.55)),
        ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Theme.Text),
    })

    if RefreshTeleportModeButtons then
        RefreshTeleportModeButtons()
    end

    -- Theme-picker buttons are intentionally handled separately.
    if ThemeButtons then
        for themeName, data in pairs(ThemeButtons) do
            local t = Themes[themeName]
            local active = Config.ThemeName == themeName

            data.Button.BackgroundColor3 = active and t.Accent or t.Card
            data.Button.TextColor3 = active and t.Bg or t.Text
            data.Stroke.Color = active and t.Accent or t.Stroke
            data.Stroke.Transparency = active and 0 or 0.35
        end
    end

    return true
end

        Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0.5, 0),

            or Theme.Off,

    })

        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(17, 17),

                    or UDim2.new(0, 2, 0.5, -8.5)
            },
            Enum.EasingStyle.Back
        )

        callback(state)
    end)

    return row

local function AddSlider(
    parent,
    text,
    initial,
    minValue,
    maxValue,
    callback
)
    local row = Row(parent, 48)

    local valueLabel = New("TextLabel", {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 5),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 16),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = text .. ": " .. tostring(initial),
        TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
        TextSize = 12,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        Parent = row
    })

    local back = New("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 31),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, 4),
        BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Off,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Parent = row
    })

    Corner(back, 99)

    local percent =
        math.clamp(
            (initial - minValue) /
            (maxValue - minValue),
            0,
            1
        )

    local fill = New("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Config.Accent,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Parent = back
    })

    Corner(fill, 99)

    local draggingSlider = false

    local function update(x)
        local p =
            math.clamp(
                (x - back.AbsolutePosition.X) /
                back.AbsoluteSize.X,
                0,
                1
            )

        local value =
            minValue
            +
            (maxValue - minValue) * p

        value = math.floor(value + 0.5)

        local normalized =
            (value - minValue) /
            (maxValue - minValue)

        fill.Size =
            UDim2.new(
                normalized,
                0,
                1,
                0
            )

        valueLabel.Text =
            text .. ": " .. tostring(value)

        callback(value)
    end

    back.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

        if input.UserInputType ==
            Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

            draggingSlider = true
            update(input.Position.X)

        end

    end)

    Connect(
        UserInputService.InputChanged,
        function(input)

            if draggingSlider
                and
                input.UserInputType ==
                Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then

                update(input.Position.X)

            end

        end
    )

    Connect(
        UserInputService.InputEnded,
        function(input)

            if input.UserInputType ==
                Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then

                draggingSlider = false

            end

        end
    )

    return row
end

local function StopSpectate()
    Config.Spectating = false

    if SpectateConnection then
        pcall(function()
            SpectateConnection:Disconnect()
        end)
        SpectateConnection = nil
    end

    pcall(function()
        Camera.CameraType = SavedCameraType or Enum.CameraType.Custom

        local humanoid = GetHumanoid()
        if humanoid then
            Camera.CameraSubject = SavedCameraSubject or humanoid
        else
            Camera.CameraSubject = GetRoot()
        end
    end)

    SavedCameraSubject = nil
    SavedCameraType = nil
end

local function StartSpectate(player)
    if not player or not player.Parent then
        Notify("Spectate", "Select a valid player first", "warn")
        return
    end

    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then
        Notify("Spectate", "Target character is not ready", "warn")
        return
    end

    StopSpectate()

    Config.Spectating = true
    SavedCameraSubject = Camera.CameraSubject
    SavedCameraType = Camera.CameraType

    pcall(function()
        Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        Camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
    end)

    SpectateConnection = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
        if not Config.Spectating then
            return
        end

        local newHumanoid = newCharacter:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        if newHumanoid then
            pcall(function()
                Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
                Camera.CameraSubject = newHumanoid
            end)
        end
    end)

    Notify("Spectate", "Watching " .. player.Name, "ok")
end

AddButton(
    TeleportPage,
    "Spectate Selected Player",
    function()
        if not SelectedPlayer or not SelectedPlayer.Parent then
            Notify("Spectate", "Select a player first", "warn")
            return
        end

        if Config.Spectating then
            StopSpectate()
            Notify("Spectate", "Stopped", "ok")
        else
            StartSpectate(SelectedPlayer)
        end
    end
)

--==============================================================
-- R6 AVATAR
--==============================================================

local function ConvertToR6()
    if R6ConversionBusy then
        return false
    end

    local character = GetCharacter()
    local oldRoot = GetRoot()
    local oldHumanoid = GetHumanoid()

    if not character or not oldRoot or not oldHumanoid then
        Notify("Avatar", "Character is not ready", "warn")
        return false
    end

    if oldHumanoid.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
        Notify("Avatar", "Already using R6", "ok")
        return true
    end

    R6ConversionBusy = true

    local savedCFrame = oldRoot.CFrame
    local description

    local okDescription, descriptionResult = pcall(function()
        return oldHumanoid:GetAppliedDescription()
    end)

    if not okDescription or not descriptionResult then
        R6ConversionBusy = false
        Notify("Avatar", "Could not read current avatar", "warn")
        return false
    end

    description = descriptionResult

    local okModel, r6Model = pcall(function()
        return Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescriptionAsync(
            description,
            Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6,
            Enum.AssetTypeVerification.Default
        )
    end)

    if not okModel or not r6Model then
        R6ConversionBusy = false
        Notify("Avatar", "R6 model could not be created", "warn")
        return false
    end

    r6Model.Name = LocalPlayer.Name

    local r6Root = r6Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local r6Humanoid = r6Model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if not r6Root or not r6Humanoid then
        pcall(function()
            r6Model:Destroy()
        end)

        R6ConversionBusy = false
        Notify("Avatar", "Generated R6 rig is incomplete", "warn")
        return false
    end

    pcall(function()
        r6Model:PivotTo(savedCFrame)
    end)

    r6Model.Parent = workspace

    -- Carry over the local Animate controller when one exists.
    local oldAnimate = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
    if oldAnimate and not r6Model:FindFirstChild("Animate") then
        pcall(function()
            oldAnimate:Clone().Parent = r6Model
        end)
    end

    local assigned = pcall(function()
        LocalPlayer.Character = r6Model
    end)

    if not assigned then
        r6Model.Parent = workspace
        pcall(function()
            Camera.CameraSubject = r6Humanoid
            Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        end)
    else
        pcall(function()
            Camera.CameraSubject = r6Humanoid
            Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        end)

        pcall(function()
            character:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    task.delay(0.15, function()
        if not Unloaded and r6Model and r6Model.Parent then
            pcall(function()
                r6Model:PivotTo(savedCFrame)
            end)
            pcall(function()
                Camera.CameraSubject = r6Humanoid
                Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            end)
        end
    end)

    R6ConversionBusy = false
    Notify("Avatar", "R6 avatar applied", "ok")
    return true
end

local function EnableAntiCheatBypass()
    if AntiCheatBypassEnabled then
        return true
    end

    local character = GetCharacter()
    local root = GetRoot()
    local humanoid = GetHumanoid()

    if not character or not root or not humanoid then
        Notify("AntiCheat Bypass", "Humanoid or character not ready", "warn")
        return false
    end

    AntiCheatBypassEnabled = true
    AntiCheatRemovedHumanoid = humanoid
    AntiCheatSavedCameraSubject = Camera.CameraSubject
    AntiCheatSavedCameraType = Camera.CameraType

    pcall(function()
        Camera.CameraSubject = root
        Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end)

    pcall(function()
        humanoid:Destroy()
    end)

    task.defer(function()
        if Unloaded or not AntiCheatBypassEnabled then
            return
        end
        pcall(function()
            Camera.CameraSubject = GetRoot()
            Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
        end)
    end)

    Notify("AntiCheat Bypass", "Humanoid removed. Use Reset Character to restore normally.", "ok")
    return true
end

local function ResetCharacter()
    AntiCheatBypassEnabled = false
    Config.SpeedHackEnabled = false
    StopSpeedHack()

    if TeleportFlightActive then
        StopFlyToPlayer()
    end

    StopFly()
    RestoreNoclip()

    local character = GetCharacter()
    if character then
        pcall(function()
            character:BreakJoints()
        end)
    end

    task.delay(0.35, function()
        if Unloaded then
            return
        end

        local humanoid = GetHumanoid()
        if humanoid then
            pcall(function()
                Camera.CameraSubject = humanoid
                Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            end)
        end
    end)

    Notify("Reset Character", "Resetting character to normal state...", "ok")
end

local function SetFullBright(state)
    if state then
        if not FullBrightApplied then
            OriginalLighting.Brightness = Lighting.Brightness
            OriginalLighting.ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime
            OriginalLighting.FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd
            OriginalLighting.GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows
            OriginalLighting.Ambient = Lighting.Ambient
            OriginalLighting.OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient
        end

        FullBrightApplied = true

        pcall(function()
            Lighting.Brightness = 3
            Lighting.ClockTime = 14
            Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
            Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        end)
    else
        if not FullBrightApplied then
            return
        end

        pcall(function()
            if OriginalLighting.Brightness ~= nil then
                Lighting.Brightness = OriginalLighting.Brightness
            end
            if OriginalLighting.ClockTime ~= nil then
                Lighting.ClockTime = OriginalLighting.ClockTime
            end
            if OriginalLighting.FogEnd ~= nil then
                Lighting.FogEnd = OriginalLighting.FogEnd
            end
            if OriginalLighting.GlobalShadows ~= nil then
                Lighting.GlobalShadows = OriginalLighting.GlobalShadows
            end
            if OriginalLighting.Ambient ~= nil then
                Lighting.Ambient = OriginalLighting.Ambient
            end
            if OriginalLighting.OutdoorAmbient ~= nil then
                Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = OriginalLighting.OutdoorAmbient
            end
        end)

        FullBrightApplied = false
    end
end

local function ServerHop()
    local baseUrl =
        "https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/"
        .. tostring(game.PlaceId)
        .. "/servers/Public?sortOrder=Asc&limit=100"

    local ok, response = pcall(function()
        return game:HttpGet(baseUrl)
    end)

    if not ok or not response then
        Notify("Server Hop", "HTTP request is unavailable", "warn")
        return
    end

    local decodedOk, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(response)
    end)

    if not decodedOk or not data or not data.data then
        Notify("Server Hop", "Could not read server list", "warn")
        return
    end

    for _, server in ipairs(data.data) do
        if server.id
            and server.id ~= game.JobId
            and tonumber(server.playing or 0) < tonumber(server.maxPlayers or 0)
        then
            Notify("Server Hop", "Joining another server...", "ok")

            task.defer(function()
                pcall(function()
                    TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(
                        game.PlaceId,
                        server.id,
                        LocalPlayer
                    )
                end)
            end)

            return
        end
    end

    Notify("Server Hop", "No other public server found", "warn")
end

local function RemoveESP(player)
    local data =
        ESPObjects[player]

    if not data then
        return
    end

    for _, object in pairs(data) do
        pcall(function()

            if object then
                object:Destroy()
            end

        end)
    end

    ESPObjects[player] = nil
end

local function CreateESP(player)

    if player == LocalPlayer then
        return
    end

    if not Config.ESPEnabled then
        return
    end

    local character =
        player.Character

    if not character then
        return
    end

    local head =
        character:FindFirstChild("Head")

    local root =
        character:FindFirstChild(
            "HumanoidRootPart"
        )

    if not head or not root then
        return
    end

    RemoveESP(player)

    local highlight =
        New("Highlight", {
            Name = "daparada777_ESP",
            FillColor = Config.ESPColor,
            FillTransparency = 0.72,
            OutlineColor = Config.ESPColor,
            OutlineTransparency = 0.05,

                Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop,
            Parent = character
        })

    local billboard =
        New("BillboardGui", {
            Name = "daparada777_Info",
            Adornee = head,
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(220, 36),
            StudsOffset =
                Vector3.new(0, 2.7, 0),
            AlwaysOnTop = true,
            Parent = head
        })

    local info =
        New("TextLabel", {
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = player.DisplayName,
            TextColor3 = Config.ESPColor,
            TextStrokeTransparency = 0.35,
            TextSize = 12,
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            Parent = billboard
        })

    local tracer =
        New("Frame", {
            Name = "daparada777_Tracer",
            AnchorPoint =
                Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
            Size =
                UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1.5),
            BackgroundColor3 =
                Config.ESPColor,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Visible = false,
            Parent = Gui
        })

    Corner(tracer, 99)

    ESPObjects[player] = {

    }
end
