--==============================================================
-- ESP RENDER
--==============================================================

Connect(
    RunService.RenderStepped,
    function()

        if Unloaded then
            return
        end

        if not Config.ESPEnabled then

            for _, data in pairs(
                ESPObjects
            ) do

                if data.Tracer then
                    data.Tracer.Visible =
                        false
                end

            end

            return
        end

        for _, player in ipairs(
            Players:GetPlayers()
        ) do

            if player ~= LocalPlayer then

                if not ESPObjects[player] then
                    CreateESP(player)
                end

                local data =
                    ESPObjects[player]

                if data then

                    local character =
                        player.Character

                    local root =
                        character
                        and
                        character:FindFirstChild(
                            "HumanoidRootPart"
                        )

                    if data.NameLabel then

                        local text = ""

                        if Config.NamesEnabled then
                            text =
                                player.DisplayName
                        end

                        if Config.DistanceEnabled
                            and root then

                            local myRoot =
                                GetRoot()

                            if myRoot then

                                local distance =
                                    (
                                        myRoot.Position
                                        -
                                        root.Position
                                    ).Magnitude

                                if text ~= "" then
                                    text =
                                        text
                                        ..
                                        "  "
                                end

                                text =
                                    text
                                    ..
                                    string.format(
                                        "[%dm]",
                                        distance
                                    )

                            end

                        end

                        data.NameLabel.Text =
                            text

                        data.NameLabel.Visible =
                            Config.NamesEnabled
                            or
                            Config.DistanceEnabled

                        data.NameLabel.TextColor3 =
                            Config.ESPColor

                    end

                    if data.Highlight then

                        data.Highlight.FillColor =
                            Config.ESPColor

                        data.Highlight.OutlineColor =
                            Config.ESPColor

                    end

                    if data.Tracer then

                        if Config.TracersEnabled
                            and
                            root then

                            local point,
                                onScreen =
                                Camera:
                                    WorldToViewportPoint(
                                        root.Position
                                    )

                            if onScreen then

                                local viewport =
                                    Camera.ViewportSize

                                local start =
                                    Vector2.new(
                                        viewport.X / 2,
                                        viewport.Y
                                    )

                                local finish =
                                    Vector2.new(
                                        point.X,
                                        point.Y
                                    )

                                local delta =
                                    finish - start

                                data.Tracer.Size =
                                    UDim2.fromOffset(
                                        delta.Magnitude,
                                        1.5
                                    )

                                data.Tracer.Position =
                                    UDim2.fromOffset(
                                        (
                                            start.X
                                            +
                                            finish.X
                                        ) / 2,

                                        (
                                            start.Y
                                            +
                                            finish.Y
                                        ) / 2
                                    )

                                data.Tracer.Rotation =
                                    math.deg(
                                        math.atan2(
                                            delta.Y,
                                            delta.X
                                        )
                                    )

                                data.Tracer.BackgroundColor3 =
                                    Config.ESPColor

                                data.Tracer.Visible =
                                    true

                            else

                                data.Tracer.Visible =
                                    false

                            end

                        else

                            data.Tracer.Visible =
                                false

                        end

                    end

                end

            end

        end

    end
)

function StartFlyPhysics()

    local root =
        GetRoot()

    if not root then
        return false

    if FlyVelocity then

    end

    FlyAttachment =
        New(
            "Attachment",
            {
                Name =
                    "daparada777_FlyAttachment",
                Parent =
                    root
            }
        )

    FlyVelocity =
        New(
            "LinearVelocity",
            {
                Name =
                    "daparada777_FlyVelocity",
                Attachment0 =
                    FlyAttachment,
                RelativeTo =
                    Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World,
                MaxForce =
                    math.huge,
                VectorVelocity =
                    Vector3.zero,
                Parent =
                    root
            }
        )

    FlyOrientation =
        New(
            "AlignOrientation",
            {
                Name =
                    "daparada777_FlyOrientation",
                Attachment0 =
                    FlyAttachment,

                Responsiveness =
                    20,
                CFrame =
                    Camera.CFrame,

                    root

    local humanoid =
        GetHumanoid()

    if humanoid then
        humanoid.PlatformStand =
            true
    end

    return true
end

function StopFly()

    if FlyVelocity then
        pcall(function()
            FlyVelocity:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    if FlyOrientation then
        pcall(function()
            FlyOrientation:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    if FlyAttachment then
        pcall(function()
            FlyAttachment:Destroy()
        end)
    end

    FlyVelocity = nil
    FlyOrientation = nil
    FlyAttachment = nil

    local humanoid =
        GetHumanoid()

    if humanoid then
        humanoid.PlatformStand =
            false
    end

    Config.FlyEnabled =
        false
end

StopFlyToPlayer = function()
    local wasActive = TeleportFlightActive

    if not wasActive then
        return
    end

    TeleportFlightToken += 1
    TeleportFlightActive = false
    TeleportFlightTarget = nil

    if TeleportFlightConnection then
        pcall(function()
            TeleportFlightConnection:Disconnect()
        end)
        TeleportFlightConnection = nil
    end

    local keepManualFly = TeleportFlightKeptManualFly
    TeleportFlightKeptManualFly = false

    if not keepManualFly then
        StopFly()
    else
        Config.FlyEnabled = true
    end

    if wasActive then
        Notify("Teleport", "Fly to player stopped", "ok")
    end
end

StartFlyToPlayer = function(player)
    if TeleportFlightActive then
        StopFlyToPlayer()
    end

    if not player or not player.Parent then
        Notify("Teleport", "Target player is unavailable", "warn")
        return
    end

    if not GetRoot() then
        Notify("Teleport", "Your character is not ready", "warn")
        return
    end

    if not (player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
        Notify("Teleport", "Target character is not ready", "warn")
        return
    end

    TeleportFlightKeptManualFly = Config.FlyEnabled

    if not StartFlyPhysics() then
        TeleportFlightKeptManualFly = false
        Notify("Teleport", "Could not start flight", "warn")
        return
    end

    TeleportFlightActive = true
    TeleportFlightTarget = player
    TeleportFlightToken += 1

    local token = TeleportFlightToken

    TeleportFlightConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
        if Unloaded
            or not TeleportFlightActive
            or token ~= TeleportFlightToken then
            return
        end

        local root = GetRoot()
        local targetCharacter = TeleportFlightTarget
            and TeleportFlightTarget.Character
        local targetRoot = targetCharacter
            and targetCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not root or not targetRoot then
            StopFlyToPlayer()
            return
        end

        local targetPosition = targetRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 3)
        local delta = targetPosition - root.Position
        local distance = delta.Magnitude

        local speed = math.max(40, Config.FlySpeed)
        local stepDistance = speed * math.max(deltaTime, 1 / 240)

        if distance <= math.max(5, stepDistance) then
            pcall(function()
                root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 3)
            end)

            local name = TeleportFlightTarget.Name
            local keepManualFly = TeleportFlightKeptManualFly

            TeleportFlightToken += 1
            TeleportFlightActive = false
            TeleportFlightTarget = nil

            if TeleportFlightConnection then
                pcall(function()
                    TeleportFlightConnection:Disconnect()
                end)
                TeleportFlightConnection = nil
            end

            TeleportFlightKeptManualFly = false

            if not keepManualFly then
                StopFly()
            else
                Config.FlyEnabled = true
            end

            Notify("Teleport", "Arrived at " .. name, "ok")
            return
        end

        if FlyVelocity then
            FlyVelocity.VectorVelocity = delta.Unit * speed
        end

        if FlyOrientation then
            pcall(function()
                FlyOrientation.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(
                    Vector3.zero,
                    delta.Unit
                )
            end)
        end
    end)

    Notify(
        "Teleport",
        "Flying to " .. PlayerDisplay(player),
        "ok"
    )
end

Connect(
    RunService.RenderStepped,
    function()

        if Unloaded then
            return
        end

        if not Config.FlyEnabled then
            return
        end

        if TeleportFlightActive then
            return
        end

        if not FlyVelocity then
            if not StartFlyPhysics() then
                return
            end
        end

        local movement =
            Vector3.zero

        local cameraCF =
            Camera.CFrame

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(
            Enum.KeyCode.W
        ) then
            movement +=
                cameraCF.LookVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(
            Enum.KeyCode.S
        ) then
            movement -=
                cameraCF.LookVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(
            Enum.KeyCode.D
        ) then
            movement +=
                cameraCF.RightVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(
            Enum.KeyCode.A
        ) then
            movement -=
                cameraCF.RightVector
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(
            Enum.KeyCode.Space
        ) then
            movement +=
                Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(
            Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl
        ) then
            movement -=
                Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        if movement.Magnitude > 0 then
            movement =
                movement.Unit
        end

        FlyVelocity.VectorVelocity =
            movement * Config.FlySpeed

        if movement.Magnitude > 0
            and FlyOrientation then

            FlyOrientation.CFrame =
                CFrame.lookAt(
                    Vector3.zero,
                    movement
                )

        end

        flyStatusText = "Fly: ON"

    end
)

--==============================================================
-- SPEED HACK
--==============================================================

local SavedWalkSpeed = nil

local function StopSpeedHack()
    SavedWalkSpeed = nil
end

local function GetSpeedHackDirection()
    local cameraCFrame = Camera.CFrame

    local forward = Vector3.new(cameraCFrame.LookVector.X, 0, cameraCFrame.LookVector.Z)
    local right = Vector3.new(cameraCFrame.RightVector.X, 0, cameraCFrame.RightVector.Z)

    if forward.Magnitude > 0 then
        forward = forward.Unit
    end
    if right.Magnitude > 0 then
        right = right.Unit
    end

    local direction = Vector3.zero

    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
        direction += forward
    end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
        direction -= forward
    end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
        direction += right
    end
    if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
        direction -= right
    end

    if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
        return direction.Unit
    end

    local humanoid = GetHumanoid()
    if humanoid and humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
        return humanoid.MoveDirection.Unit
    end

    return Vector3.zero
end

local function StartSpeedHack()
    local root = GetRoot()
    if not root then
        return false
    end

    local humanoid = GetHumanoid()
    if humanoid and SavedWalkSpeed == nil then
        SavedWalkSpeed = humanoid.WalkSpeed
    end

    return true
end

local function UpdateSpeedHack(deltaTime)
    if not Config.SpeedHackEnabled then
        return
    end

    if not StartSpeedHack() then
        return
    end

    local root = GetRoot()
    if not root then
        return
    end

    local direction = GetSpeedHackDirection()
    if direction.Magnitude <= 0 or Config.SpeedHack <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local totalDistance = Config.SpeedHack * deltaTime
    local maxMicroStep = 3.5
    local steps = math.max(1, math.ceil(totalDistance / maxMicroStep))
    local stepDistance = totalDistance / steps

    for _ = 1, steps do
        if Unloaded or not Config.SpeedHackEnabled then
            break
        end

        local currentRoot = GetRoot()
        if not currentRoot then
            break
        end

        pcall(function()
            currentRoot.CFrame = currentRoot.CFrame + direction * stepDistance
        end)
    end
end

Connect(
    RunService.Heartbeat,
    function(deltaTime)
        if Unloaded then
            return
        end

        if Config.SpeedHackEnabled then
            UpdateSpeedHack(deltaTime)
        end
    end
)

--==============================================================
-- FPS / UPTIME
--==============================================================



Connect(
    RunService.Heartbeat,
    function()

        if Unloaded then
            return
        end

        FPSFrames += 1

        local now =
            os.clock()

        if now - FPSLast >= 0.5 then

            FPSValue =
                math.floor(
                    FPSFrames
                    /
                    (now - FPSLast)
                    +
                    0.5
                )

            FPSFrames = 0
            FPSLast = now

            FPSLabel.Text =
                tostring(FPSValue)
                ..
                " FPS"

        end

        local totalSeconds =
            math.floor(
                os.clock()
                -
                StartClock
            )

        local hours =
            math.floor(
                totalSeconds / 3600
            )

        local minutes =
            math.floor(
                (totalSeconds % 3600) / 60
            )

        local seconds =
            totalSeconds % 60

        Uptime.Text =
            string.format(
                "%02d:%02d:%02d",
                hours,
                minutes,
                seconds
            )

    end
)

--==============================================================
-- OPEN / CLOSE
--==============================================================

local function SetOpen(state)

    if OpenState == state then
        return
    end

    OpenState =
        state

    if PlayerPopup and not state then
        PlayerPopup.Visible = false
    end

    if state then

        PlaySound(OpenSound)

        Main.Visible =
            true

        Main.Size =
            UDim2.fromOffset(
                0,
                0
            )

        Main.BackgroundTransparency =
            1

        Tween(
            Main,
            0.34,
            {
                Size =
                    UDim2.fromOffset(
                        768,
                        496
                    ),
                BackgroundTransparency =
                    0.22
            },
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
        )

        if Config.Blur then

            Tween(
                GlassBlur,
                0.34,
                {
                    Size = 14
                }
            )

        end

    else

        PlaySound(ClickSound)

        Tween(
            Main,
            0.24,
            {
                Size =
                    UDim2.fromOffset(
                        0,
                        0
                    ),
                BackgroundTransparency =
                    1
            },
            Enum.EasingStyle.Quint
        )

        Tween(
            GlassBlur,
            0.24,
            {
                Size = 0
            }
        )

        task.delay(
            0.26,
            function()

                if not OpenState then
                    Main.Visible =
                        false
                end

            end
        )

    end

end

--==============================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==============================================================

local Dragging = false
local DragStart = nil
local MainStart = nil

Header.InputBegan:Connect(
    function(input)

        if input.UserInputType ==
            Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or
            input.UserInputType ==
            Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            Dragging =
                true

            DragStart =
                input.Position

            MainStart =
                Main.Position

        end

    end
)

Connect(
    UserInputService.InputChanged,
    function(input)

        if not Dragging then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType ~=
            Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            and
            input.UserInputType ~=
            Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
            return
        end

        local delta =
            input.Position
            -
            DragStart

        Main.Position =
            UDim2.new(
                MainStart.X.Scale,
                MainStart.X.Offset + delta.X,
                MainStart.Y.Scale,
                MainStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y
            )

    end
)

Connect(
    UserInputService.InputEnded,
    function(input)

        if input.UserInputType ==
            Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or
            input.UserInputType ==
            Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

            Dragging =
                false

        end

    end
)

Connect(
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded,
    function()
        task.wait(0.4)

        if Unloaded then
            return
        end

        R6ConversionBusy = false

        if Config.Spectating then
            StopSpectate()
        end

        if Config.FullBrightEnabled then
            SetFullBright(true)
        end

        local wasFlyEnabled = Config.FlyEnabled

        if TeleportFlightActive then
            StopFlyToPlayer()
        end

        StopFly()
        StopSpeedHack()
        RestoreNoclip()

        AntiCheatBypassEnabled = false
        AntiCheatRemovedHumanoid = nil
        OriginalJumpPower = nil
        OriginalJumpHeight = nil
        OriginalUseJumpPower = nil

        if Config.SpeedHackEnabled then
            StartSpeedHack()
        end

        if JumpPowerConfigured then
            ApplyJumpPower()
        end

        local newHumanoid = GetHumanoid()
        if newHumanoid then
            pcall(function()
                Camera.CameraType = AntiCheatSavedCameraType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
                Camera.CameraSubject = newHumanoid
            end)
        else
            pcall(function()
                Camera.CameraSubject = GetRoot()
                Camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
            end)
        end

        AntiCheatSavedCameraSubject = nil
        AntiCheatSavedCameraType = nil

        if wasFlyEnabled then
            if StartFlyPhysics() then
                Config.FlyEnabled = true
            else
                Config.FlyEnabled = false
            end
        end
    end
)

--==============================================================
-- MENU KEY
--==============================================================

Connect(
    UserInputService.InputBegan,
    function(input, gameProcessed)

        if gameProcessed then
            return
        end

        if Unloaded then
            return
        end

        if input.UserInputType ~=
            Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            return
        end

        if input.KeyCode ==
            Config.MenuKey then

            SetOpen(
                not OpenState
            )

        end

    end
)

--==============================================================
-- UNLOAD
--==============================================================

function Unload()

    if Unloaded then
        return
    end

    Unloaded =
        true

    OpenState =
        false

    Config.SpeedHackEnabled = false
    StopSpeedHack()
    if TeleportFlightActive then
        StopFlyToPlayer()
    end
    StopFly()
    RestoreNoclip()
    if JumpPowerConfigured then
        RestoreJumpPower()
    end
    AntiCheatBypassEnabled = false
    AntiCheatRemovedHumanoid = nil
    AntiCheatSavedCameraSubject = nil
    AntiCheatSavedCameraType = nil
    R6ConversionBusy = false

    if Config.Spectating then
        StopSpectate()
    end

    StopAntiAFK()

    if FullBrightApplied then
        SetFullBright(false)
    end

    Config.SavedPosition = nil

    for player, data in pairs(
        ESPObjects
    ) do

        if data then

            for _, object in pairs(
                data
            ) do

                pcall(
                    function()

                        if object then
                            object:Destroy()
                        end

                    end
                )

            end

        end

        ESPObjects[player] =
            nil

    end

    for player, connections in pairs(
        PlayerConnections
    ) do

        for _, connection in pairs(
            connections
        ) do

            pcall(
                function()
                    connection:Disconnect()
                end
            )

        end

    end

    for _, connection in ipairs(
        Connections
    ) do

        pcall(
            function()
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
        )

    end

    pcall(function()
        PlayerPopup.Visible = false
    end)

    pcall(function()
        GlassBlur:Destroy()
    end)

    pcall(function()
        Gui:Destroy()
    end)

end

-- DEFAULT
--==============================================================

RefreshTeleportModeButtons()
SelectTab("MAIN")
ApplyTheme(Config.ThemeName)

    end
)
